question: Brand loyalty exists when consumers repeat-purchase your brand rather than swapping and switching between brands. It is widely agreed that it is far more expensive to have to ﬁnd a new customer than to keep existing ones happy, so brand loyalty is crucial for achieving high-proﬁt margins. For charities, it is important to set a marketing objective of improving brand loyalty. If existing donors can be persuaded to set up a direct debit to the charity, its cash ﬂow will improve signiﬁcantly. To enhance, or reposition a brand’s image Although some brands stay fresh for generations (Marmite is over 100 years old) others become jaded due to changes in consumer tastes and lifestyles. At this point, the ﬁrms need to refresh the brand image to keep the products relevant to the target market. A clear objective must be set. For instance: what brand attributes do we want to create? What do we want the brand to stand for? Repositioning This occurs when a ﬁrm aims to change a brand 's image so that the brand appeals to a new target market. Twelve years into its life cycle, McVitie’s decided to reposition its Hobnobs biscuit brand. Hobnobs had been positioned as a homely, quite healthy biscuit for middle-aged consumers. Research pointed McVitie’s in a new direction: younger, more male, and less dull. So new packaging was designed and then launched in conjunction with a new, brighter advertising campaign. In 2013 Hobnobs sales were worth 36 million pounds, 9 percent up on the previous year.
answer: Brand loyalty exists when repeat-purchase happen and is crucial for achieving high-proﬁt margins, so for charities, it is important to set a marketing objective of improving brand loyalty, and the ﬁrms need to refresh the brand image to keep the products relevant to the target market and set a clear objective, but repositioning occurs when a ﬁrm aims to a change a brand 's image, so that the brand appeals to a new target market. (Word count: 74)
question_zh: 当消费者重复购买您的品牌而不是在品牌之间交换时，就会存在品牌忠诚度。人们普遍认为，寻找新客户的成本远高于让现有客户满意的成本，因此品牌忠诚度对于实现高利润率至关重要。对于慈善机构来说，设定提高品牌忠诚度的营销目标非常重要。如果能够说服现有的捐助者向该慈善机构直接借记，其现金流将显着改善。提升或重新定位品牌形象 尽管有些品牌几代人都保持新鲜感（Marmite 已有 100 多年的历史），但其他品牌却因消费者品味和生活方式的变化而变得厌倦。此时，企业需要更新品牌形象，以保持产品与目标市场的相关性。必须设定明确的目标。例如：我们想要创造什么品牌属性？我们希望品牌代表什么？重新定位 当公司旨在改变品牌形象以使该品牌吸引新的目标市场时就会发生这种情况。进入其生命周期十二年后，麦维他决定重新定位其 Hobnobs 饼干品牌。 Hobnobs被定位为一种适合中年消费者的家常、相当健康的饼干。研究为麦维他指明了一个新的方向：更年轻、更男性化、不那么沉闷。因此设计了新的包装，然后与新的、更明亮的广告活动一起推出。 2013 年 Hobnobs 销售额达 3600 万英镑，比上年增长 9%。
answer_zh: 当重复购买发生时，品牌忠诚度就存在，并且对于实现高利润率至关重要，因此对于慈善机构来说，制定提高品牌忠诚度的营销目标非常重要，企业需要更新品牌形象以保持产品与目标市场的相关性并设定明确的目标，但当企业旨在改变品牌形象，使品牌吸引新的目标市场时，就会发生重新定位。 （字数：74）

question: One of Guinness World Records ' more unusual awards was presented at the National Maritime Museum yesterday. After a 100-day trial, the timepiece known as Clock B – which had been sealed in a clear plastic box to prevent tampering – was oﬃcially declared, by Guinness, to be the world 's "most accurate mechanical clock with a pendulum swinging in free air ". It was an intriguing enough award. But what is really astonishing is that the clock was designed more than 250 years ago by a man who was derided at the time for "an incoherence and absurdity that was little short of the symptoms of insanity", and whose plans for the clock lay ignored for two centuries. The derision was poured on John Harrison, the British clockmaker whose marine chronometers had revolutionized seafaring in the 18th century (and who was the subject of Longitude by Dava Sobel). His subsequent claim – that he would go on to make a pendulum timepiece that was accurate to within a second over a 100-day period – triggered widespread ridicule. The task was simply impossible, it was declared. But now the last laugh lies with Harrison. At a conference, Harrison Decoded: Towards a Perfect Pendulum Clock, held at Greenwich yesterday, observatory scientists revealed that a clock that had been built to the clockmaker’s exact speciﬁcations had run for 100 days during oﬃcial tests and had lost only ﬁve-eighths of a second in that period.
answer: 回忆要点：今天考到一个Clock B的题 ，应该是新题吧 说一个很精确的pendulum 的clock ，精确到100年内的差您小于1s (好像是这样的) ， 获得了吉尼斯世界记录 ， 然后讲了发明的过程 ， 250年前的一个人最早发明出来的 ，但是没完成 ， 由一个叫John Harrison的人完成的 ， 当时有很多人都觉得不可能完成 ，但是John 笑到了最后。 google 了一下 ，没找到原文 ，但是有类似的。基本上的就是下文的意思 In 2015, Guinness World Records presented an unusual award at the National Maritime Museum in Greenwich (the “G” in “GMT”), England. After a 100-day testing while sealed in a clear plastic box to prevent tampering, Clock B by Martin Burgess and completed by Charles Frodsham and Co. was oﬃcially declared to be the world’s “most accurate mechanical clock with a pendulum swinging in free air. ” The timepiece Clock B, was declared to be the world’s “most accurate mechanical clock with a pendulum swinging in free air” and was designed over 250 years ago as “ an incoherence an absurdity that was little short of the symptoms of insanity”; John Harrison claimed to make a timepiece that was accurate to within a second over a 100-day period, but now the last laugh lies with him.(Word count: 75) 性；
question_zh: 吉尼斯世界纪录最不寻常的奖项之一昨天在国家海事博物馆颁发。经过 100 天的试用后，这款名为 Clock B 的时计被密封在透明塑料盒中以防止篡改，被吉尼斯世界纪录正式宣布为世界上“在自由空气中摆锤摆动的最精确的机械钟”。这是一个足够有趣的奖项。但真正令人惊讶的是，这座钟是在 250 多年前由一位当时被嘲笑为“语无伦次和荒谬，近乎精神错乱的症状”的人设计的，而他的钟设计方案在两个世纪以来一直被忽视。英国钟表匠约翰·哈里森 (John Harrison) 受到了嘲笑，他的航海天文钟彻底改变了 18 世纪的航海业（达瓦·索贝尔 (Dava Sobel) 的《经度》的主题就是他）。他随后声称自己将继续制造一款在 100 天内精确到一秒的摆钟，引发了广泛的嘲笑。据宣称，这项任务根本不可能完成。但现在笑到最后的是哈里森。昨天在格林威治举行的“哈里森解码：迈向完美摆钟”会议上，天文台科学家透露，按照钟表匠的精确规格制造的时钟在官方测试中运行了 100 天，在此期间仅损失了八分之五秒。

question: Almost 120 years ago, during the ﬁrst Gilded Age, sociologist Thorstein Veblen coined the term “conspicuous consumption” . He used it to refer to rich people ﬂaunting their wealth through wasteful spending. Why buy a thousand-dollar suit when a hundred-dollar one serves the same function? The answer, Veblen said, was power. The rich asserted their dominance by showing how much money they could burn on things they didn’t need. While radical at the time, Veblen’s observation seems obvious now. In the intervening decades, conspicuous consumption has become deeply embedded in the texture of American capitalism. Our new Gilded Age is even more Veblenian than the last. Today’s captains of industry publicize their social position with private islands and superyachts while the president of the United States covers nearly everything he owns in gold. But the acquisition of insanely expensive commodities isn’t the only way that modern elites project power. More recently, another form of status display has emerged. In the new Gilded Age, identifying oneself as a member of the ruling class doesn’t just require conspicuous consumption. It requires conspicuous production. If conspicuous consumption involves the worship of luxury, conspicuous production involves the worship of labor. It isn’t about how much you spend. It’s about how hard you work. Nowhere is the cult of conspicuous production more visible than among America’s CEOs.
answer: ‘Conspicuous consumption’ proposed by Veblen refers to rich people ﬂaunting their wealth through wasteful spending, and the cause behind this phenomenon is power, and Veblen’s observation seems obvious now, although it was radical in the past, but the way that modern elites project power includes not only conspicuous consumption but also conspicuous production.
question_zh: 大约 120 年前，在第一个镀金时代，社会学家托尔斯坦·维勃伦 (Thorstein Veblen) 创造了“炫耀性消费”一词。他用这个词来指代通过挥霍浪费来炫耀财富的富人。当一套百美元的套装具有同样的功能时，为什么还要购买一套千美元的套装呢？维勃伦说，答案就是权力。富人通过展示他们可以在不需要的东西上花多少钱来维护自己的统治地位。凡勃伦的观察在当时看来很激进，但现在看来是显而易见的。在随后的几十年里，炫耀性消费已深深植根于美国资本主义的结构中。我们的新镀金时代比上一个时代更加维勃伦式。今天的工业领袖通过私人岛屿和超级游艇来宣传他们的社会地位，而美国总统几乎用黄金覆盖了他所拥有的一切。但购买极其昂贵的商品并不是现代精英投射权力的唯一方式。最近，出现了另一种状态显示形式。在新的镀金时代，将自己视为统治阶级的一员不仅仅需要炫耀性消费。它需要引人注目的生产。如果说炫耀性消费涉及对奢侈的崇拜，那么炫耀性生产则涉及对劳动的崇拜。这与你花了多少钱无关。这与你工作的努力程度有关。对炫耀性生产的崇拜在美国的首席执行官中最为明显。
answer_zh: 凡勃伦提出的“炫耀性消费”是指富人通过挥霍浪费来炫耀自己的财富，这种现象背后的原因是权力，凡勃伦的观察现在看来是显而易见的，虽然在过去是激进的，但现代精英投射权力的方式不仅包括炫耀性消费，还包括炫耀性生产。

question: When Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web, he surely didn’t anticipate that children would end up becoming some of its main users. Most start using the internet at the average age of three – and as recent research shows, children now spend more time playing and socializing online than watching television programs. Given this change in habits, it is not surprising that a recent House of Lords report has raised online safety and behavior as an important issue. The report said that for children, learning to survive in a world dominated by the internet should be as important as reading and writing. The House of Lords Communications Committee also warned that children should not be leaving school without “a well-rounded understanding of the digital world” . It also suggested that the government should think about implementing new legal requirements and a code of conduct companies would have to adhere to, which would help to bring the internet up to “child-friendly standards” . Of course, trying to rectify this lack of child-centered design is not an easy task, but one that requires the cooperation and goodwill of many sectors. It will need to involve consultation with technology, education, legal and policy experts. And it would also be a good idea to make children and young people part of the process.
answer: As children have become the main users of the world wide web, a recent report has raised that online safety and behavior is an important issue, stating that children should not be leaving school without "a well-rounded understanding of the digital world " and that the government should also think about implementing new legal requirements and a code of conduct, which requires the cooperation and goodwill of many sectors.
question_zh: 当蒂姆·伯纳斯·李发明万维网时，他肯定没有预料到儿童最终会成为其主要用户之一。大多数人平均在三岁时开始使用互联网，最近的研究表明，孩子们现在花在网上玩耍和社交的时间比看电视节目的时间还要多。鉴于这种习惯的变化，上议院最近的一份报告将网络安全和行为列为一个重要问题也就不足为奇了。报告称，对于儿童来说，学习在互联网主导的世界中生存应该与阅读和写作同样重要。上议院通讯委员会还警告说，如果孩子们“对数字世界没有全面的了解”，就不应该离开学校。它还建议政府应考虑实施新的法律要求和公司必须遵守的行为准则，这将有助于使互联网达到“儿童友好标准”。当然，试图纠正这种以儿童为中心的设计的不足并不是一件容易的事，而是需要许多部门的合作和善意。它需要与技术、教育、法律和政策专家进行协商。让儿童和青少年参与这一过程也是一个好主意。
answer_zh: 随着儿童成为万维网的主要用户，最近的一份报告提出，网络安全和行为是一个重要问题，指出儿童在没有“对数字世界有全面了解”的情况下不应该离开学校，政府也应该考虑实施新的法律要求和行为准则，这需要多方面的合作和善意。

question: As an art, architecture is essentially abstract and nonrepresentational and involves the manipulation of the relationships of spaces, volumes, planes, masses, and voids. Time is also an important factor in architecture, since a building is usually comprehended in a succession of experiences rather than all at once. In most architecture ,there is no one vantage point from which the whole structure can be understood. The use of light and shadow, as well as surface decoration, can greatly enhance a structure. The analysis of building types provides an insight into past cultures and eras. Behind each of the greater styles lies not a casual trend nor a vogue, but a period of serious and urgent experimentation directed toward answering the needs of a speciﬁc way of life. Climate, methods of labor, available materials, and economy of means all impose their dictates. Each of the greater styles has been aided by the discovery of new construction methods. Once developed, a method survives tenaciously, giving way only when social changes or new building techniques have reduced it. That evolutionary process is exempliﬁed by the history of modern architecture, which developed from the ﬁrst uses of structural iron and steel in the mid-19th century.
answer: Architecture is abstract and nonrepresentational and involves the manipulation of the relationships of diﬀerent elements including time, and additionally, no one vantage point from which the whole structure can be understood; the analysis of building types provides an insight into past cultures and eras, but experimentation directed toward answering the needs of a speciﬁc way of life; once a method survives tenaciously, giving way only when social changes or new building techniques have reduced it.
question_zh: 作为一门艺术，建筑本质上是抽象的、非具象的，涉及对空间、体积、平面、质量和空隙关系的操纵。时间也是建筑中的一个重要因素，因为一座建筑通常是通过一系列的经历而不是一次性的经历来理解的。在大多数建筑中，没有一个有利的位置可以理解整个结构。光影以及表面装饰的使用可以极大地增强结构。对建筑类型的分析提供了对过去文化和时代的洞察。每一种更伟大的风格背后并不是一种随意的趋势，也不是一种时尚，而是一段认真而紧迫的实验时期，旨在满足特定生活方式的需求。气候、劳动方法、可用材料和手段经济都强加了它们的决定。每一种更伟大的风格都得益于新建筑方法的发现。一种方法一旦发展起来，就会顽强地生存下来，只有当社会变化或新的建筑技术削弱它时，它才会被淘汰。现代建筑的历史就是这一演变过程的例证，现代建筑是从 19 世纪中叶首次使用结构钢铁开始发展起来的。
answer_zh: 建筑是抽象的、非具象的，涉及对包括时间在内的不同元素关系的操纵，此外，没有一个有利的角度可以理解整个结构；对建筑类型的分析提供了对过去文化和时代的洞察，但实验旨在满足特定生活方式的需求；一旦一种方法顽强地生存下来，只有当社会变化或新的建筑技术削弱它时才会让位。

The 1920s moviegoers ' experience was largely dominated by silent movies but saw the introduction of synchronized sound. In the 1920s movie stars were really stars - with huge salaries, the fashions and activities of the Hollywood greats echoed around the world and 100,000 people would gather in cities all over the world, including such diverse cities as London and Moscow, to greet Mary Pickford and Douglas Fairbanks when they toured Europe. Early silent movies were often accompanied by live piano or organ music and provided enormous entertainment value to audiences captivated by the experience of watching moving pictures on the silver screen. Although there had been previous attempts to introduce sound, it wasn 't until 1923 that a synchronized soundtrack was photographically recorded and printed onto the side of the strip of motion picture ﬁlm and was made it into a commercially distributed movie. It would still be seven long years before talking pictures gained total supremacy and ﬁnally replaced the silent ﬁlm era. The ﬁrst movie theatres were called Nickelodeons and were very basic compared to the luxurious picture palaces that followed but what an aura of excitement, of laughter, fun and tears surrounded them! Before the introduction of movie soundtracks, movies were often accompanied by scripted music from a piano.
answer: The 1920s moviegoers’ experience was largely dominated by silent movies, but saw the introduction of synchronized sound, and the movie stars were really stars, and early silent movies were often accompanied by live piano or organ music and provided enormous entertainment value to audiences, although there had been previous attempts to introduce sound, and the ﬁrst movie theaters were called Nickelodeons, and were very basic compared to the luxurious picture palaces.
question_zh: 20 年代的电影观众的体验主要以无声电影为主，但也看到了同步声音的引入。 1920年代的电影明星才是真正的明星——拿着巨额片酬，好莱坞巨星的时尚和活动在世界各地回响，10万人会聚集在世界各地的城市，包括伦敦和莫斯科等不同的城市，迎接玛丽·碧克馥和道格拉斯·范朋克在欧洲巡演时的到来。早期的无声电影通常伴有现场钢琴或管风琴音乐，为沉迷于银幕上观看电影的观众提供了巨大的娱乐价值。尽管之前曾尝试过引入声音，但直到 1923 年，同步配乐才被摄影录制并打印到电影胶片的侧面，并制作成商业发行的电影。距离有声电影完全占据主导地位并最终取代无声电影时代还需要漫长的七年时间。第一个电影院被称为 Nickelodeons，与后来的豪华电影院相比非常简陋，但它们周围充满了兴奋、笑声、乐趣和泪水！在引入电影配乐之前，电影通常配有钢琴演奏的脚本音乐。
answer_zh: 20年代的观影体验主要以无声电影为主，但看到了同步声音的引入，而且电影明星都是真正的明星，早期的无声电影常常伴有现场钢琴或管风琴音乐，为观众提供了巨大的娱乐价值，尽管之前也曾尝试过引入声音，而且第一家电影院被称为尼克儿童频道，与豪华的电影宫殿相比，非常简陋。

Asda has become the ﬁrst food retailer in the country to measure how much customers can save by cutting back on food waste, thanks to a Knowledge Transfer Partnership (KTP) with the University of Leeds. The idea behind the KTP was for the University, using Asda 's customer insight data, to apply its research to identify, investigate and implement ways of helping customers to reduce their food waste. This was one of the ﬁrst times that a major retailer had tried to deliver large-scale sustainability changes, with the two-year project seen as a way for Asda to position itself as a true innovator in this area. The campaign focused on providing customers with advice on everything from food storage and labeling to creative recipes for leftovers. Meanwhile, in-store events encouraged customers to make changes in their own homes. In fact, two million customers have said they will make changes to how they deal with food waste in their own homes, leading to an average saving of 57 pounds per customer, as well as a reduction in waste. A key aspect of a KTP is that an associate is employed by the University to work in the ﬁrm and help deliver the desired outcomes of the KTP. As a part of the collaboration with Asda, Laura Babbs was given the task of driving forward the sustainability "changes (spelling c h a n g e s) "changes in the retailer. As a result of the success of her work, Laura eventually became a permanent member of the team at Asda.
answer: Asda has become the ﬁrst food retailer to measure how much customers can save by cutting back on food waste with KTP ，and this major retailer had tried to deliver large-scale sustainability changes as the ﬁrst true innovator, and the campaign focused on providing customers with advice on everything from food storage and labeling, to creative recipes for leftovers, especially at home, and a key aspect of a KTP is associating with University. (74)
question_zh: 由于与利兹大学建立了知识转移合作伙伴关系 (KTP)，阿斯达已成为该国第一家衡量顾客通过减少食物浪费可以节省多少钱的食品零售商。 KTP 背后的想法是让大学利用 Asda 的客户洞察数据，应用其研究来确定、调查和实施帮助客户减少食物浪费的方法。这是大型零售商第一次尝试进行大规模的可持续发展变革，这个为期两年的项目被视为阿斯达将自己定位为该领域真正创新者的一种方式。该活动的重点是为顾客提供从食品储存和标签到剩菜创意食谱等各个方面的建议。与此同时，店内活动鼓励顾客在自己的家里做出改变。事实上，已有 200 万顾客表示，他们将改变处理自己家中食物浪费的方式，从而使每位顾客平均节省 57 磅，并减少浪费。 KTP 的一个关键方面是大学雇用一名员工在公司工作并帮助实现 KTP 的预期成果。作为与 Asda 合作的一部分，Laura Babbs 的任务是推动零售商的可持续发展“变革（拼写变化）”变革。由于工作的成功，劳拉最终成为阿斯达团队的永久成员。
answer_zh: Asda 已成为第一家衡量顾客通过 KTP 减少食物浪费可以节省多少钱的食品零售商，这家大型零售商作为第一个真正的创新者，曾试图实现大规模的可持续发展变革，该活动的重点是为顾客提供从食品储存和标签到剩菜创意食谱（尤其是在家里）的各种建议，而 KTP 的一个关键方面是与大学的合作。 (74)

In a study in the current issue of the journal PLOS One, a team of scientists in Germany showed experts and novices simple geometric objects and simple chess positions and asked the subjects to identify them. Reaction times were measured and brain activity was monitored using functional M.R.I. scans. On the identiﬁcation of the geometric objects, the subjects performed the same, showing that the chess experts had no special visualization skills. When the subjects were shown the chess positions, the experts identiﬁed them faster. Focusing on an element of an earlier study on pattern and object recognition by chess experts, the researchers had expected to see parts of the left hemispheres of the experts' brains — which are involved in object recognition — react more quickly than those of the novices when they performed the chess tasks. But the reaction times were the same. What set the experts apart was that parts of their right brain hemispheres — which are more involved in pattern recognition — also lit up with activity. The experts were processing the information in two places at once. The researchers also found that when the subjects were shown the chess diagrams, the novices looked directly at the pieces to recognize them, while the experts looked in the middle of the boards and took everything in with their peripheral vision.
answer: The research shows that the chess experts had no special visualization skills, but they identiﬁed chess positions faster, and the research shows that the left hemispheres of the experts ' brains in object recognition react more quickly than those of the novices in chess task with the same reaction time, and the experts were processing the information in both parts of brains at once, and they use peripheral vision. (70)
question_zh: 在最新一期《PLOS One》杂志上的一项研究中，德国的一组科学家向专家和新手展示了简单的几何物体和简单的国际象棋位置，并要求受试者识别它们。使用功能性磁共振成像测量反应时间并监测大脑活动。扫描。在识别几何物体时，受试者表现相同，这表明国际象棋专家没有特殊的可视化技能。当受试者看到国际象棋的棋局时，专家们能更快地识别出棋局。研究人员关注了国际象棋专家早期关于模式和物体识别的研究的一个要素，他们原本期望看到专家大脑左半球的部分——参与物体识别——在执行国际象棋任务时比新手反应更快。但反应时间是相同的。让专家们与众不同的是，他们右脑半球的部分区域——更多地参与模式识别——也活跃起来。专家们同时在两个地方处理信息。研究人员还发现，当向受试者展示国际象棋图时，新手会直接看着棋子来识别它们，而专家则看着棋盘的中间，并用余光观察一切。
answer_zh: 研究表明，国际象棋专家没有特殊的可视化技能，但他们识别棋局的速度更快，而且研究表明，在相同反应时间下，专家的大脑左半球在物体识别中比国际象棋新手的左半球反应更快，而且专家的大脑两个半球同时处理信息，他们使用的是周边视觉。 (70)

question: According to researchers, the invisibility cloak illusion stems from the belief that we are much more socially observant than the people around us. This means that, while we watch and wonder about other people as much as possible, we often think that people around us are less aware. This illusion occurs because, while we are fully aware of our own impressions and speculations about other people, we have no idea about what those other people are thinking unless they choose to share with us, something that rarely happens except in exceptional circumstances. To better understand what is happening, it is important to consider the groundbreaking research by Amos Tversky and Daniel Kahneman on cognitive biases. When people make judgments about other people in social situations, they often depend on speciﬁc biases such as the availability heuristic, i.e., that we attach more signiﬁcance to thoughts that come to mind easily. This is why we consider thoughts about other people as being more important than thoughts about inanimate objects. And so, as we look around us, we tend to focus our thoughts on the people we see and what they happen to be doing. Which is why people-watching can be so addictive. What adds to the sense that we are relatively invisible to others is that people tend to be as discreet as possible about their people-watching. Just because other people aren 't sharing their observations with us, it 's easy to pretend that they are not as observant as we are. Of course, people may share their people-watching observations with anyone they happen to be with but, for the most part, that only applies to something remarkable enough to comment on. For most of us, what we are seeing tends to be extremely private and not to be shared with others.
answer: Illusion stems from the belief that we are much more socially observant than the people around us, and it is the result of our impressions and speculations; when people make judgments about other people in social situations, they often depend on speciﬁc biases, and this is why we consider thoughts about other people as being more important than thoughts about inanimate objects. (62)
question_zh: 研究人员表示，隐形斗篷幻觉源于这样一种信念：我们比周围的人更善于观察社会。这意味着，当我们尽可能多地观察和思考其他人时，我们常常认为我们周围的人不太了解。出现这种错觉是因为，虽然我们完全了解自己对其他人的印象和猜测，但我们不知道其他人在想什么，除非他们选择与我们分享，这种情况很少发生，除非在特殊情况下。为了更好地理解正在发生的事情，重要的是要考虑阿莫斯·特沃斯基和丹尼尔·卡尼曼关于认知偏差的开创性研究。当人们在社交场合对其他人做出判断时，他们常常依赖于特定的偏见，例如可用性启发法，即我们更重视容易浮现在脑海中的想法。这就是为什么我们认为对他人的想法比对无生命物体的想法更重要。因此，当我们环顾四周时，我们倾向于将注意力集中在我们看到的人和他们正在做的事情上。这就是为什么观察人们会如此令人上瘾。人们在观察别人时往往尽可能谨慎，这更增加了我们相对于其他人来说是隐形的感觉。仅仅因为其他人没有与我们分享他们的观察结果，就很容易假装他们不像我们那么善于观察。当然，人们可能会与他们碰巧在一起的任何人分享他们观察他人的观察结果，但在大多数情况下，这只适用于足以发表评论的引人注目的事情。对于我们大多数人来说，我们所看到的往往是极其私密的，不会与他人分享。
answer_zh: 幻觉源于一种信念，即我们比周围的人更善于观察社会，它是我们印象和猜测的结果；当人们在社交场合对他人做出判断时，他们常常依赖于特定的偏见，这就是为什么我们认为对他人的想法比对无生命物体的想法更重要。 (62)

question: Contrary to popular belief, babies under a few months don 't grin at you because they're copying your own smile, according to new research. Many studies have indicated that from birth, infants imitate the behaviors and facial expressions of the adults around them. However, a team of Australian, South African and British researchers have released a study this week that refutes this widespread belief. "Numerous studies from the 1980s and 90s indicated no imitation by newborns, while others claimed it was there, " says Virginia Slaughter, a biologist at the University of Queensland and co-author of the study. "We wanted to clear up the confusion because the 'fact ' that newborns imitate is widely cited, not just in the ﬁelds of psychology, neuroscience and paediatrics, but also in popular sources for parents. ’ The international research team, led by Janine Oostenbroek, a psychologist at the University of York in the UK, exposed more than 100 infants to a broad range of gestures and recorded their responses at one, two, six and nine weeks of age. The gestures included social cues like adults poking their tongues out, frowning or grinning, as well as non-social cues such as pointing or opening a box. The ﬁndings showed no link between behaviors exhibited by babies in their ﬁrst few months and the gestures they were exposed to. The babies were just as likely to exhibit gestures they had never seen before as repeat ones they had. For instance, babies stuck their tongues out just as frequently if they were being exposed to pointing or opening a box, rather than anything to do with mouths or tongues.
answer: Many studies have indicated that from birth, infants imitate the behaviors and facial expressions of the adults around them, however, some researches indicated no imitation by newborns, moreover, new ﬁndings showed no link between behaviors exhibited by babies in their ﬁrst few months and the gestures they were exposed to, therefore , the babies were just as likely to exhibit gestures they had never seen before as repeat ones they had. (Word count:71)
question_zh: 最新研究表明，与普遍看法相反，几个月以下的婴儿不会对你笑，因为他们在模仿你自己的微笑。许多研究表明，婴儿从出生起就会模仿周围成年人的行为和面部表情。然而，由澳大利亚、南非和英国研究人员组成的团队本周发布了一项研究，驳斥了这一普遍看法。 “20 世纪 80 年代和 90 年代的大量研究表明新生儿没有模仿，而其他人则声称它存在，”昆士兰大学生物学家、该研究的合著者弗吉尼亚·斯劳特 (Virginia Slaughter) 说。 “我们想要澄清这一困惑，因为新生儿模仿的‘事实’不仅在心理学、神经科学和儿科领域被广泛引用，而且在父母的流行资料中也被广泛引用。”由英国约克大学心理学家 Janine Oostenbroek 领导的国际研究小组让 100 多名婴儿接触了各种手势，并记录了他们在 1、2、6 和 9 周大时的反应。这些手势包括成年人伸出舌头、皱眉或咧嘴笑等社交暗示，以及指向或打开盒子等非社交暗示。研究结果表明，婴儿在最初几个月表现出的行为与他们所接触过的手势之间没有联系，例如，如果婴儿被指着或打开盒子，他们就会同样频繁地表现出以前从未见过的手势。盒子，而不是任何与嘴或舌头有关的东西。
answer_zh: 许多研究表明，婴儿从出生起就会模仿周围成年人的行为和面部表情，然而，一些研究表明新生儿不会模仿，而且，新的研究结果表明，婴儿在最初几个月表现出的行为与他们所接触到的手势之间没有联系，因此，婴儿表现出他们以前从未见过的手势的可能性与他们重复出现的手势一样。 （字数：71）

question: Most of the time when I embark on such an investigation, it quickly becomes clear that matters are much more complicated and ambiguous several shades grayer than I thought going in. Not this time. The deeper I delved into the confused and confusing thicket of nutritional science, sorting through the long-running fats versus carb wars, the ﬁber skirmishes and the raging dietary supplement debates, the simpler the picture gradually became. I learned that in fact, science knows a lot less about nutrition than you would expect - that in fact, nutrition science is, to put it charitably, a very young science. Ifs still trying to ﬁgure out exactly what happens in your body when you sip a soda, or what is going on deep in the soul of a carrot to make it so good for you, or why in the world you have so many neurons - brain cells! - in your stomach, of all places. It’s a fascinating subject, and someday the ﬁeld may produce deﬁnitive answers to the nutritional questions that concern us, but — as nutritionists themselves will tell you - they’re not there yet. Not even close. Nutrition science, which after all only got started less than two hundred years ago, is today approximately where surgery was in the year 1650 -very promising, and very interesting to watch, but are you ready to let them operate on you? I think I 'll wait a while.
answer: Nutrition science is a very young science, as it tries to ﬁgure out exactly what happens in your body, in addition, it is a fascinating subject, as nutritionists themselves will tell you that they are not there yet, in short, nutrition science only gets started less than two hundred years ago, and it is still a long time to understand it. (Word count:61)
question_zh: 大多数时候，当我开始这样的调查时，很快就会发现事情比我想象的要复杂和模糊得多。但这次不是。我越是深入研究混乱的营养科学，对长期存在的脂肪与碳水化合物之战、纤维冲突和激烈的膳食补充剂争论进行梳理，情况就逐渐变得更加简单。我了解到，事实上，科学对营养的了解比你想象的要少得多——事实上，宽容地说，营养科学是一门非常年轻的科学。如果你还在试图弄清楚当你喝一杯苏打水时你的身体到底发生了什么，或者胡萝卜的灵魂深处发生了什么使它对你如此有益，或者为什么世界上你有这么多的神经元——脑细胞！ - 在你的胃里，在所有地方。这是一个引人入胜的话题，有一天，这个领域可能会对我们关心的营养问题给出明确的答案，但是——正如营养学家自己会告诉你的那样——他们还没有做到。甚至还差得远。营养科学毕竟在不到 200 年前才刚刚起步，而今天的营养科学大约相当于 1650 年外科手术的水平 - 非常有前途，也非常有趣，但是您准备好让他们为您进行手术了吗？我想我会等一会儿。
answer_zh: 营养科学是一门非常年轻的科学，因为它试图弄清楚你的身体到底发生了什么，此外，它是一个令人着迷的学科，因为营养学家自己会告诉你他们还没有达到这一点，简而言之，营养科学在不到两百年前才开始，要理解它还有很长的时间。 （字数：61）

question: A plunging oil price has dragged UK inﬂation to zero over recent months. But analysts say the fall in retail prices cannot solely be attributed to oil. Discount retailers continue to steal market share from established industry giants, taking an increased chunk of both food and non-food markets. And, as retail "the big supermarkets have had to respond to this by bringing down their own 'rip oﬀ ' prices ". The result is a sector-wide fall in prices paid at the till. The growth of online retailers has also brought prices down, in part due to the case with which customers can compare prices and purchase goods elsewhere if they ﬁnd an item cheaper on a competitor 's site. Retailers are also reluctant to oﬀer diﬀerent prices in their physical and online stores, according to retail analyst Richard Hyman, which means shops are forced to cut pieces on the high street. An ever-expanding range of shops is also to blame, according to Mr. Hyman. "Overcapacity is the biggest of the issues aﬀecting prices, " he says. "In the last 10 years, online alone has added the equivalent of 110m square feet of trading space- that 's roughly equal to 65 additional Westﬁeld London shopping malls. An increase in supply of retailers, with no increase in demand, has left the industry massively oversupplied. "
answer: The fall in retail prices cannot solely be attributed to oil, and discount retailers continue to steal market share, taking an increased chunk of both food and non-food markets, and the result is a sector-wide fall in prices paid, while the growth of online retailers has also brought prices down, and an ever-expanding range of shops is also to blame, but overcapacity is the biggest of the issues aﬀecting prices including oversupply. (72)
question_zh: 近几个月来，油价暴跌已将英国通胀率拖至零。但分析师表示，零售价格的下跌不能仅仅归因于石油。折扣零售商继续从老牌行业巨头手中夺取市场份额，在食品和非食品市场上占据越来越大的份额。而且，作为零售业，“大型超市必须通过降低自己的‘宰客’价格来应对这一问题”。结果是整个行业收银台支付的价格下降。在线零售商的增长也拉低了价格，部分原因在于，如果客户在竞争对手的网站上发现更便宜的商品，他们可以比较价格并在其他地方购买商品。零售分析师理查德·海曼表示，零售商也不愿意在实体店和网上商店提供不同的价格，这意味着商店被迫在大街上削减商品。海曼先生表示，不断扩大的商店也是罪魁祸首。 “产能过剩是影响价格的最大问题，”他说。 “在过去 10 年里，仅网上交易就增加了相当于 1.1 亿平方英尺的交易空间，大约相当于新增 65 个伦敦 Westfield 购物中心。零售商供应的增加，而需求却没有增加，导致该行业严重供过于求。”
answer_zh: 零售价格的下降不能仅仅归因于石油，折扣零售商继续抢占市场份额，在食品和非食品市场上占据越来越大的份额，结果是整个行业支付的价格下降，而在线零售商的增长也拉低了价格，不断扩大的商店也是罪魁祸首，但产能过剩是影响价格的最大问题，包括供应过剩。 (72)

question: Manufacturing is no longer simply about making physical products. Changes in consumer demand, the nature of products, the economics of production, and the economics of the supply chain have led to a fundamental shift in the way companies do business. Customers demand personalization and customization as the line between consumer and creator continues to blur. Added sensors and connectivity turn “dumb” products into “smart” ones, while products increasingly become platforms—and even move into the realm of services. As technology continues to advance exponentially, barriers to entry, commercialization, and learning are eroding. New market entrants with access to new tools can operate at a much smaller scale, enabling them to create oﬀerings once the sole province of major incumbents. While large-scale production will always dominate some segments of the value chain, innovative manufacturing models—distributed small-scale local manufacturing, loosely coupled manufacturing ecosystems, and agile manufacturing—are arising to take advantage of these new opportunities. Meanwhile, the boundary separating product makers from product sellers is increasingly permeable. Manufacturers are feeling the pressure—and gaining the ability—to increase both speed to market and customer engagement. And numerous factors are leading manufacturers to build to order rather than building to stock. In this environment, intermediaries that create value by holding inventory are becoming less and less necessary. Together, these shifts have made it more diﬃcult to create value in traditional ways. At the same time, as products become less objects of value in their own right and more the means for accessing information and experiences, creating and capturing value has moved from delivering physical objects to enabling that access.
answer: There is a fundamental shift in manufacturing, and customers demand personalization or customization as the line between consumer and creator continues to blur, while barriers to entry, commercialization, and learning are eroding with market entrance, tools and opportunities, and the boundary separating product makers from product sellers is permeable, and manufacturers to build to order, creating and capturing value has moved from delivering physical objects to enabling the access of information and experiences. (73)
question_zh: 制造业不再仅仅是制造实物产品。消费者需求、产品性质、生产经济学和供应链经济学的变化导致公司经营方式发生根本性转变。随着消费者和创作者之间的界限不断模糊，客户需要个性化和定制化。增加的传感器和连接将“笨”产品变成“智能”产品，而产品越来越多地成为平台，甚至进入服务领域。随着技术不断呈指数级发展，进入、商业化和学习的障碍正在消失。能够使用新工具的新市场进入者可以以更小的规模运营，使他们能够创造曾经是主要现有企业的唯一领域的产品。虽然大规模生产始终会主导价值链的某些环节，但创新的制造模式——分布式小规模本地制造、松散耦合的制造生态系统和敏捷制造——正在兴起，以利用这些新机遇。与此同时，产品制造商与产品销售商之间的界限越来越具有渗透性。制造商感受到了提高上市速度和客户参与度的压力，并获得了能力。许多因素导致制造商按订单生产而不是按库存生产。在这种环境下，通过持有库存创造价值的中介机构变得越来越没有必要。总之，这些转变使得以传统方式创造价值变得更加困难。与此同时，随着产品本身不再是有价值的对象，而更多地成为获取信息和体验的手段，创造和获取价值已经从提供物理对象转变为实现这种访问。
answer_zh: 制造业发生了根本性转变，随着消费者和创造者之间的界限不断模糊，客户要求个性化或定制化，而进入、商业化和学习的壁垒随着市场准入、工具和机会的增加而逐渐消失，产品制造商与产品销售商之间的界限是可渗透的，制造商按订单生产、创造和获取价值已经从提供物理对象转变为支持信息和体验的获取。 (73)

question: In a study conducted in Tubingen, Germany, chess experts and novices were shown geometric objects and chess positions, and were later asked to identify each one of them. Their reaction times and brain activity were closely monitored with the use of functional MRI scans. In the ﬁrst part, which was recognizing the geometric objects, results reveal that the subjects’ performance didn’t show any dissimilarities, which implied that the experts’ visualization skills were no better than the amateurs’. However, during the identiﬁcation of the chess positions, the experts were seen to have performed signiﬁcantly faster and better. As the researchers geared toward an element of a study previously conducted on pattern and object recognition by the chess experts, they had anticipated noticing areas of the left hemisphere of the experts’ brains (involved in object recognition) to be more reactive when they performed the tasks. However, the reaction times of the subjects were virtually identical. The very thing that sets the experts apart from the amateurs is that the former’s right brain hemispheres (involved in pattern recognition) were to be seen to have also lit up during the activity. Therefore,both sides of the experts’ brains were active, processing information in two places simultaneously. The researchers added that when they showed the chess diagrams to the subjects, they observed that the amateurs relied on looking at the pieces intently to be able to recognize them, whereas the experts merely relied on their peripheral vision and looked across the boards.
answer: The research shows that the chess experts had no special visualization skills ，but the they identiﬁed chess positions faster, and the research shows that the left hemispheres of the experts ' brains in object recognition react more quickly than those of the novices in chess task with the same reaction time, and the experts were processing the information in both parts of brains at once, and they use peripheral vision. (70)
question_zh: 在德国图宾根进行的一项研究中，国际象棋专家和新手看到了几何物体和国际象棋位置，然后被要求识别它们中的每一个。他们的反应时间和大脑活动通过功能性核磁共振扫描进行密切监测。第一部分是识别几何物体，结果显示受试者的表现没有表现出任何差异，这意味着专家的可视化能力并不比业余爱好者好。然而，在确定棋局过程中，专家们的表现明显更快更好。当研究人员针对国际象棋专家之前进行的模式和物体识别研究的一个要素时，他们预计会注意到专家大脑左半球的区域（涉及物体识别）在执行任务时会更加反应。然而，受试者的反应时间实际上是相同的。专家与业余爱好者的区别在于，专家的右脑半球（参与模式识别）在活动过程中也会亮起。于是，专家们的左右脑都活跃起来，同时在两地处理信息。研究人员补充说，当他们向受试者展示国际象棋图时，他们发现业余爱好者依靠专心地观察棋子来识别它们，而专家则仅仅依靠他们的余光来观察棋盘。
answer_zh: 研究表明，国际象棋专家没有特殊的可视化技能，但他们识别棋局的速度更快，而且研究表明，在相同反应时间的情况下，专家大脑的左半球在物体识别中的反应速度比新手在国际象棋任务中的反应更快，而且专家的大脑的两个半球同时处理信息，他们使用的是周边视觉。 (70)

question: As our global population continues to expand, the pressure on our planet 's resources intensiﬁes. A central challenge we face is how to meet the skyrocketing energy demand required to support this growth. This isn 't just about keeping the lights on; it 's about powering every facet of our modern lives. With the population growth, the demand for resources has been growing as well. This creates a complex chain reaction across various sectors. There is an expected increase in demand for various alternative resources, raw materials, timber for papermaking, and of course, energy. This surge is understandable. More people need more homes, consumer goods, and packaging, all of which require vast amounts of materials and the energy to produce them. However, the strain is not limited to renewable resources. The increase in demand also happens in the non-renewable resource ﬁeld, such as metal. These metals are essential for construction, technology, and infrastructure, but their supply is ﬁnite. Furthermore, our reliance on fossil fuels remains deeply entrenched. The demand for petrol, diesel and crude oil is also huge to cope with the demand for manufacturing plastics and for powering the global transportation network that moves these goods around the world. This interconnected demand presents a critical dilemma. On one hand, we need these resources to maintain and improve living standards. On the other, their extraction and consumption have signiﬁcant environmental consequences. This is why a sustainable path forward is crucial. People should ensure the natural world can still work well to ensure future well-being because the world population rises.
answer: With the global population expanding , the pressure on resources grows , so there is an increase in demand for alternative resources , raw materials , timber , energy and non - renewable resources , which presents a critical dilemma that resources are needed to maintain and improve living standards , but their extraction and consumption will cause environmental consequences , environmental consequences , thus a sustainable path forward is needed as people should safeguard future well - being by ensuring that the natural environment can work well .
question_zh: 随着全球人口持续增长，地球资源面临的压力日益加大。我们面临的一个核心挑战是如何满足支持这种增长所需的飙升的能源需求。这不仅仅是为了让灯保持亮着；它为我们现代生活的方方面面提供动力。随着人口的增长，对资源的需求也不断增长。这在各个部门之间造成了复杂的连锁反应。预计对各种替代资源、原材料、造纸木材，当然还有能源的需求将会增加。这种激增是可以理解的。越来越多的人需要更多的房屋、消费品和包装，所有这些都需要大量的材料和能源来生产。然而，压力不仅限于可再生资源。需求的增加也发生在金属等不可再生资源领域。这些金属对于建筑、技术和基础设施至关重要，但它们的供应是有限的。此外，我们对化石燃料的依赖仍然根深蒂固。对汽油、柴油和原油的需求也很大，以满足制造塑料的需求以及为在世界各地运输这些货物的全球运输网络提供动力的需求。这种相互关联的需求提出了一个严重的困境。一方面，我们需要这些资源来维持和提高生活水平。另一方面，它们的提取和消费会对环境产生重大影响。这就是为什么可持续的前进道路至关重要。随着世界人口的增长，人们应该确保自然世界仍然能够良好运转，以确保未来的福祉。
answer_zh: 随着全球人口的增长，资源压力加大，对替代资源、原材料、木材、能源和不可再生资源的需求增加，这就出现了一个严峻的困境：需要资源来维持和提高生活水平，但资源的开采和消耗会造成环境后果，因此需要一条可持续的前进道路，因为人们应该通过确保自然环境良好运转来保障未来的福祉。

question: Fish are being killed, and prevented from reaching maturity, by the litter of plastic particles ﬁnding their way into the world’s oceans, new research has proved. Some young ﬁsh have been found to prefer tiny particles of plastic to their natural food sources, eﬀectively starving them before they can reproduce. The growing problem of microplastics – tiny particles of polymer-type materials from modern industry – has been thought for several years to be a peril for ﬁsh, but the study published on Thursday is the ﬁrst to prove the damage in trials. Microplastics are near-indestructible in natural environments. They enter the oceans through litter, when waste such as plastic bags, packaging and other convenience materials are discarded. Vast amounts of these end up in the sea, through inadequate waste disposal systems and sewage outfall. Another growing source is microbeads, tiny particles of hard plastics that are used in cosmetics, for instance as an abrasive in modern skin cleaners. These easily enter waterways as they are washed oﬀ as they are used, ﬂushed down drains and forgotten, but can last for decades in our oceans. The impact of these materials has been hard to measure, despite being a growing source of concern. Small particles of plastics have been found in seabirds, ﬁsh and whales, which swallow the materials but cannot digest them, leading to a build-up in their digestive tracts. For the ﬁrst time, scientists have demonstrated that ﬁsh exposed to such materials during their development show stunted growth and increased mortality rates, as well as changed behavior that could endanger their survival.
answer: The ﬁsh exposed to plastic materials during their development show stunted growth and increased mortality rates, as well as changed behavior that could endanger their survival, and litter of plastic particles in oceans is damaging and growing problem, because animals cannot digest them,and particles including long-lasting microbeads are near-indestructible in natural environments, which stems from inadequate waste disposal systems and sewage outfall, while these materials has been hard to measure.(Word count:70)
question_zh: 新的研究证明，塑料颗粒垃圾进入世界海洋，导致鱼类死亡，并导致鱼类无法成熟。人们发现，一些幼鱼更喜欢微小的塑料颗粒，而不是它们的天然食物来源，这实际上使它们在繁殖之前挨饿。微塑料（来自现代工业的聚合物型材料的微小颗粒）的问题日益严重，多年来一直被认为对鱼类构成威胁，但周四发表的研究首次在试验中证明了这种损害。微塑料在自然环境中几乎坚不可摧。它们通过垃圾进入海洋，塑料袋、包装和其他便利材料等废物被丢弃。通过不完善的废物处理系统和污水排放口，大量的垃圾最终流入大海。另一个不断增长的来源是微珠，这是化妆品中使用的硬塑料微小颗粒，例如作为现代皮肤清洁剂中的研磨剂。它们很容易进入水道，因为它们在使用时被冲走，冲进下水道并被遗忘，但可以在我们的海洋中持续数十年。尽管这些材料的影响日益引起人们的关注，但其影响却很难衡量。海鸟、鱼类和鲸鱼体内发现了塑料小颗粒，它们吞下这些物质但无法消化它们，导致它们在消化道中堆积。科学家们首次证明，在发育过程中暴露于此类材料的鱼类会出现生长迟缓和死亡率增加，以及可能危及其生存的行为改变。
answer_zh: 在发育过程中接触塑料材料的鱼类表现出生长迟缓和死亡率增加，以及可能危及其生存的行为改变，海洋中的塑料颗粒垃圾具有破坏性和日益严重的问题，因为动物无法消化它们，而包括持久微珠在内的颗粒在自然环境中几乎坚不可摧，这是由于废物处理系统和污水排放口不足，而这些材料一直难以测量。（字数：70）
