question_zh: 联合国环境规划署 (UNEP) 今天表示，作为全球气候网络的一部分，从 2014 年索契奥运会到每年一度的挪威峡湾摩托艇比赛，全球各地的重大体育赛事都在努力消除碳足迹。环境署执行主任阿奇姆·施泰纳表示，体育赛事是加入该网络的最新参与者，对于激发全球进一步的环境行动尤为重要。 2014 年索契冬奥会和冬残奥会将在黑海沿岸和高耸的白雪皑皑的高加索山脉之间独特的自然环境中举行，组织者表示，他们将在节能和可再生能源方面投入估计 17.5 亿美元。该投资将致力于改善交通基础设施，抵消电力、航空旅行和地面交通使用产生的温室气体排放，索契国家公园的重新造林以及城市绿化带的开发。
answer_zh: 联合国环境规划署（UNEP）表示，作为全球气候网络的参与者，全球体育赛事都在努力消除碳足迹，但2014年索契冬奥会和冬残奥会的组织者表示，他们将投资于节能和可再生能源，致力于改善交通基础设施、抵消航空旅行和地面交通产生的温室气体排放、索契国家公园重新造林和开发绿化带。

question: The ways of life Upper Paleolithic people are known through the remains of meals scattered around their hearts, together with many tools and weapons and the debris left over from their making. The people were hunter-gathers who lived exclusively form what they could ﬁnd in nature without practicing either agriculture or herding. They hunted the bigger herbivores, while berries, leaves, roots, wild fruit and mushrooms probably played a major role in their diet. Their hunting was indiscriminate perhaps because so many animals were about they did not need to spare pregnant females or the young. In the cave of Enlene, for example, many bones of reindeer and bison fetuses were found. Apparently, upper Paleolithic people hunted like other predators and killed the weakest prey ﬁrst. They did, however, sometimes concentrate on salmon suns and migrating herds of reindeer. Contrary to popular beliefs about cave man, upper Paleolithic people did not live deep inside caves. They rather close the foot of cliﬀs, especially when an overhang provided good shelter. On the plains and in the valleys, they used tents made from hides of the animals they killed. At the time, on the great Russian plains, they built huts with huge boned and tusks collected from skeletons of mammals. Men hunted mostly with spears, the bow and arrow were probably not invented until the Magdalenian period that came at the end of the Upper Paleolithic. Tools and weapons, made out of wood or reindeer antlers, often had ﬂint cutting edges. Flint snappers were skillful, and traditions in ﬂint snapping were purchased for thousands of years. This continuity means that they must have been carefully thought how to ﬁnd good ﬂint modules and how to snap them in order to make knives, buries (chisel-like tools) or scrapers, which could be used for various purposes.
answer: Upper Paleolithic people, whose ways of life are known through the remains of meals scattered around hearths, tools and weapons and the debris left over, were hunter-gathers who lived from what they found in nature without practicing agriculture or herding, but they did sometimes concentrate on salmon suns and migrating reindeer herds, and choose the foot of cliﬀs with an overhang to live, which is contrary to popular belief about cave man. (Word count:73)
question_zh: 旧石器时代晚期人们的生活方式是通过散落在他们心脏周围的食物残骸、许多工具和武器以及他们制造时留下的碎片来了解的。这些人以狩猎采集为生，完全靠自然界中能找到的东西生活，不从事农业或畜牧业。他们捕猎较大的食草动物，而浆果、树叶、根、野果和蘑菇可能在他们的饮食中发挥着主要作用。他们的狩猎是不分青红皂白的，也许是因为周围有太多的动物，他们不需要放过怀孕的雌性或幼崽。例如，在恩莱内洞穴中，发现了许多驯鹿和野牛胎儿的骨头。显然，旧石器时代晚期的人们像其他掠食者一样捕猎，首先杀死最弱的猎物。然而，他们有时确实会关注鲑鱼的阳光和迁徙的驯鹿群。与穴居人的普遍看法相反，旧石器时代晚期的人们并不生活在洞穴深处。它们宁愿封闭悬崖脚部，特别是当悬垂物提供良好的庇护时。在平原和山谷中，他们使用用他们杀死的动物的皮制成的帐篷。当时，在俄罗斯大平原上，他们用从哺乳动物骨骼中收集的巨大骨头和象牙建造了小屋。人类主要使用长矛狩猎，弓箭可能直到旧石器时代晚期的马格达林时期才被发明。用木头或驯鹿角制成的工具和武器通常有燧石刀刃。燧石笛鲷技艺精湛，燧石笛鲷的传统传承了数千年。这种连续性意味着他们必须仔细考虑如何找到好的燧石模块以及如何折断它们以制造刀具、埋葬器（类似凿子的工具）或刮刀，这些可以用于各种目的。
answer_zh: 旧石器时代晚期人们的生活方式是通过散落在壁炉旁的食物残骸、工具和武器以及遗留下来的残骸来了解的，他们是狩猎采集者，他们以自然界中的发现为生，不从事农业或畜牧业，但他们有时确实专注于鲑鱼太阳和迁徙的驯鹿群，并选择悬垂的悬崖脚下居住，这与穴居人的普遍看法相反。 （字数：73）

question: Plants serve as the conduit of energy into the biosphere, provide food and materials used by humans, and they shape our environment. According to Ehrhardt and Frommer, the three major challenges facing humanity in our time are food, energy, and environmental degradation. All three are plant- related. All of our food is produced by plants, either directly or indirectly via animals that eat them. Plants are a source of energy production. And they are intimately involved in climate change and a major factor in a variety of environmental concerns, including agricultural expansion and its impact on habitat destruction and waterway pollution. What‘s more, none of these issues are independent of each other. Climate change places additional stresses on the food supply and various habitats. So, plant research is instrumental in addressing all of these problems and moving into the future. For plant research to move signiﬁcantly forward, Ehrhardt and Formmer say technological development is critical, both to test existing hypotheses and to gain new information and generate fresh hypotheses. If we are to make headway in understanding how these essential organisms function and build the foundation for a sustainable future, then we need to apply the most advanced technologies available to the study of plant life, they say.
answer: According to Ehrhardt and Frommer, food, energy, and environmental degradation, the three major challenges facing humanity are plant related, as plants are a source of food and energy production, a major factor in environmental concerns, and intimately involved in climate change, hence plant research is instrumental in addressing problems and moving into the future, and technological development is critical, both to test existing hypotheses and to gain new information and generate fresh ones.
question_zh: 植物是能量进入生物圈的管道，提供人类使用的食物和材料，并塑造我们的环境。埃尔哈特和弗罗默认为，我们这个时代人类面临的三大挑战是粮食、能源和环境退化。这三个都与植物有关。我们所有的食物都是由植物直接或间接通过食用植物的动物生产的。植物是能源生产的来源。它们与气候变化密切相关，也是各种环境问题的主要因素，包括农业扩张及其对栖息地破坏和水道污染的影响。更重要的是，这些问题都不是相互独立的。气候变化给粮食供应和各种栖息地带来了额外的压力。因此，植物研究有助于解决所有这些问题并走向未来。埃尔哈特和福默表示，为了使植物研究取得重大进展，技术发展至关重要，既可以检验现有的假设，也可以获取新的信息并产生新的假设。他们说，如果我们要在理解这些重要生物体如何发挥作用并为可持续未来奠定基础方面取得进展，那么我们需要将最先进的技术应用于植物生命的研究。
answer_zh: Ehrhardt和Frommer认为，粮食、能源和环境退化，人类面临的三大挑战都与植物有关，因为植物是粮食和能源生产的来源，是环境问题的主要因素，并且与气候变化密切相关，因此植物研究有助于解决问题和走向未来，而技术发展至关重要，既可以检验现有的假设，也可以获取新的信息并产生新的假设。

question: A government is the organization, machinery, or agency, through which a political unit exercises its authority, controls and administers public policy, and directs and controls the actions of its members or subjects. The government makes laws, regulate economies, conduct relations with other countries, provide infrastructure and services, and maintain an army and a police force amongst others on behalf of the people of the country. Democracy is any system of government in which the people have the rule. The ancient Greeks used the word democracy to mean government by the many in contrast to the government by the few. The key to democracy is that the people hold ultimate power. Abraham Lincoln best captured this spirit by describing democracy as a government of the people, by the people, for the people. Democratic government is opposed to an authoritative government, where the participation of its citizenry is limited or prohibited, and a state of anarchy where no form of government exists.
answer: A government is the organization, which controls the public policy, make laws, regulate economies, conduct relations with other countries, also maintain an army and a police force, while democracy is any system of government in which the people have the rule, as a government of people, as opposed to an authoritative government, where the participation of its citizenry is limited or prohibited, and a state of anarchy where no form of government exists.(Word count:73)
question_zh: 政府是一个组织、机制或机构，政治单位通过它行使其权力，控制和管理公共政策，并指导和控制其成员或臣民的行动。政府代表本国人民制定法律、监管经济、处理与其他国家的关系、提供基础设施和服务、维持军队和警察部队等。民主是人民当家作主的任何政府制度。古希腊人使用民主一词来表示多数人的政府，以区别于少数人的政府。民主的关键是人民掌握最终权力。亚伯拉罕·林肯通过将民主描述为民有、民治、民享的政府，最好地体现了这种精神。民主政府反对限制或禁止公民参与的权威政府，以及不存在任何形式的政府的无政府状态。
answer_zh: 政府是控制公共政策、制定法律、调节经济、处理与其他国家关系、维持军队和警察部队的组织，而民主是人民统治的任何政府制度，是人民的政府，而不是权威政府，在权威政府中，公民的参与受到限制或禁止，以及不存在任何形式的政府的无政府状态。（字数：73）

question: It 's very easy to forget about what 's in the ground beneath our feet and why it 's so important to protect it. One tablespoon of soil contains more organisms than there are people on Earth; billions of bacteria, fungi and other microorganisms combine with minerals, water, air and organic matter to create a living system that supports plants and, in turn, all life. Healthy soil can store as much as 3,750 tons of water per hectare, reducing the risk of ﬂooding, and the International Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) has said that 89% of all agricultural emissions could be mitigated if we improved the health of our soil. Good soil management also increases disease resistance in livestock and ultimately drives proﬁts for farmers - yet soil and its impact on the health of our animals has, over recent decades, been one of the most neglected links in UK agriculture. Over the last 50 years' agriculture has become increasingly dependent on chemical fertilizers, with applications today around 10 times higher than in the 1950s. Farmers often think the chemical fertilizer NPK (nitrogen, phosphorous and potassium) provides all the nutrition a plant requires, but it also has a detrimental eﬀect on the long-term health of the land: research suggests there are fewer than 100 harvests left in many of the world 's soils.
answer: Soil contains many organisms , which creates a living system that supports plants and all life, and healthy soil reduces the risk of ﬂooding, good soil management also increases disease resistance in livestock and ultimately drives proﬁts for farmers , yet soil and its impact on the health of our animals has been one of the most neglected links in UK agriculture.
question_zh: 我们很容易忘记脚下的土地上有什么以及为什么保护它如此重要。一汤匙土壤中含有的生物体数量比地球上的人口还要多；数十亿细菌、真菌和其他微生物与矿物质、水、空气和有机物结合，形成一个支持植物乃至所有生命的生命系统。健康的土壤每公顷可储存多达 3,750 吨水，从而降低洪水风险，国际气候变化专门委员会 (IPCC) 表示，如果我们改善土壤的健康状况，则可以减少 89% 的农业排放量。良好的土壤管理还可以提高牲畜的抗病能力，并最终为农民带来利润——然而，近几十年来，土壤及其对动物健康的影响一直是英国农业中最被忽视的环节之一。过去 50 年来，农业越来越依赖化肥，如今的化肥施用量比 20 世纪 50 年代高出约 10 倍。农民通常认为化肥 NPK（氮、磷和钾）可以提供植物所需的所有营养，但它也会对土地的长期健康产生不利影响：研究表明，世界上许多土壤的收成还不足 100 倍。
answer_zh: 土壤含有许多生物体，它创造了一个支持植物和所有生命的生命系统，健康的土壤可以降低洪水的风险，良好的土壤管理还可以提高牲畜的抗病能力，并最终为农民带来利润，但土壤及其对动物健康的影响一直是英国农业中最被忽视的环节之一。

question: The Home Oﬃce s periodic British Crime Survey estimates that the true level of crime (the sorts, anyway, which inform the oﬃcial ﬁgures) is about four times that which is registered in the annual statistics. Quite often, especially in the ﬁnancial services sector, businesses do not report crimes against themselves for fear of lowering their public image. Many citizens today are not insured against car theft or property loss (because they cannot aﬀord the premiums), so they have no incentive to tell the police if they become victims. A steep statistical rise in crime can sometimes arise not from a real growth in a particular type of conduct but a new policing policy - oﬀences of "lewd dancing " rose by about 300 percent during 12 months in the 1980s in Manchester, but only because the zealous Chief Constable James Anderton had deployed a great many oﬃcers in gay nightclubs. Sometimes the enactment of a new range of oﬀenses or the possibility of committing old oﬀenses in a new way (like computer oﬀenses involving fraud and deception) can cause an upward jolt in crime levels. The ﬁgures just released show a startling jump in street robbery but much of this seems to be a very particular crime: the theft of the now ubiquitous mobile phones. Conversely, if crimes like joyriding and some assaults are kept out of the categories measured in the annual statistics, as is the case, the oﬃcial ﬁgures do not reﬂect even what is reported to the police as a criminal. The way that crime statistics are compiled by the Home Oﬃce is also relevant. From April 1998, police forces started to count crime in a way which, according to the government, will give "a more robust statistical measure ". Under the new rules, crime is recorded as one crime per victim. Some crimes, like assaults, have always been recorded in this way, so the main impact of the change will be in the area of property oﬀenses. Shop thefts, for example, were the old rules counted oﬀenders, will now count victims. Multiple thefts from cars in a car park with a barrier were previously counted as one oﬀense but are now counted as separate oﬀenses.
answer: According to the Home Oﬃce’ s periodic British Crime Survey, the true level of crime is about four times that which is registered in the annual statistics, which was not from a real growth in a particular conduct but from a new policing policy, and under such more robust statistical measure, crime is recorded as one crime per victim even in the area of property, resulting in separate oﬀences being counted. (Word count:72)
question_zh: 英国内政部定期进行的英国犯罪调查估计，真实的犯罪水平（无论如何，为官方数据提供信息的犯罪类型）大约是年度统计数据的四倍。通常，尤其是在金融服务领域，企业不会举报针对自己的犯罪行为，因为担心会降低其公众形象。如今，许多公民没有购买汽车盗窃或财产损失保险（因为他们负担不起保费），因此如果他们成为受害者，他们没有动力告诉警方。统计上犯罪率的急剧上升有时并非源于某种特定行为的实际增长，而是源于新的治安政策——20世纪80年代曼彻斯特的“猥亵舞蹈”犯罪在12个月内增加了约300%，但这只是因为热心的警察局长詹姆斯·安德顿在同性恋夜总会部署了大量警员。有时，一系列新犯罪行为的实施或以新方式实施旧犯罪行为的可能性（例如涉及欺诈和欺骗的计算机犯罪）可能会导致犯罪水平上升。刚刚公布的数据显示，街头抢劫数量惊人地猛增，但其中大部分似乎是一种非常特殊的犯罪：盗窃现在无处不在的手机。相反，如果像这种情况那样，兜风和一些袭击等犯罪行为被排除在年度统计数据的衡量范围之外，那么官方数据甚至不能反映向警方报告的犯罪行为。内政部编制犯罪统计数据的方式也很重要。从 1998 年 4 月起，警察部队开始统计犯罪，据政府称，这种方式将提供“更强有力的统计措施”。根据新规则，犯罪记录为每个受害者的一次犯罪。一些犯罪行为，例如袭击，一直以这种方式记录，因此变化的主要影响将集中在财产犯罪领域。例如，商店盗窃，以前的规则被视为犯罪者，现在将被视为受害者。在设有护栏的停车场内多次盗窃汽车的行为以前被视为一项犯罪行为，但现在被视为单独的犯罪行为。
answer_zh: 根据内政部定期进行的英国犯罪调查，真实的犯罪水平约为年度统计数据的四倍，这并非来自特定行为的实际增长，而是来自新的治安政策，在这种更强有力的统计措施下，即使在财产领域，犯罪也被记录为每个受害者的一项犯罪，从而导致单独的犯罪被计数。 （字数：72）

question: In its periodic quest for culinary identity, Australia automatically looks to its indigenous ingredients, the foods that are native to this country. There can be little doubt that using an indigenous product must qualify a dish as Australian notes, Stephanie Alexander. Similarly, and without qualiﬁcation, states that a uniquely Australian food culture can only be based on foods indigenous to this country, although, as Craw remarks, proposing Australian native foods as national symbols relies more upon their association with 'nature ' and geographic origin than on common usage Notwithstanding the lack of justiﬁcation for the premise that national dishes are, of necessity, founded on ingredients native to the country. After all, Italy's gastronomic identity is tied to the non-indigenous tomato, Thailand 's indigenous chili, and the reality is that Australians do not eat indigenous foods in signiﬁcant quantities. The exceptions are ﬁsh, crustaceans, and shellﬁsh from oceans, rivers, and lakes, most of which are unarguably unique to this country. Despite valiant and well-intentioned eﬀorts today at promoting and encouraging the consumption of native resources, bush foods are not harvested or produced in suﬃcient quantities for them to be a standard component of Australian diets, nor are they generally accessible. Indigenous foods are less relevant to Australian identity today than lamb and passionfruit, both initially imported and now naturalized.
answer: Australian indigenous ingredients refer to the foods native to this country, which is opposed by Craw 's remark who stressed more on association with 'nature ' and geographic origin than common usage, but despite eﬀorts at promoting and encouraging the consumption of native resources, Australians do not eat indigenous foods in signiﬁcant quantities as bush foods are not harvested or produced suﬃciently nor accessible, so indigenous foods are less relevant to Australian identity today.
question_zh: 在定期寻求烹饪特色的过程中，澳大利亚自然而然地寻找其本土食材，即该国本土的食物。毫无疑问，使用本土产品必须使菜肴符合澳大利亚风味，Stephanie Alexander。同样，无条件地指出，独特的澳大利亚饮食文化只能基于该国本土的食品，尽管正如克劳所说，将澳大利亚本土食品作为国家象征更多地依赖于它们与“自然”和地理起源的联系，而不是普遍的用法。毕竟，意大利的美食特色与非本土番茄、泰国本土辣椒息息相关，而现实情况是，澳大利亚人并不大量食用本土食品。例外的是来自海洋、河流和湖泊的鱼类、甲壳类动物和贝类，其中大多数无疑是这个国家所独有的。尽管今天在促进和鼓励消费本土资源方面做出了勇敢和善意的努力，但丛林食物的收获或生产量不足以使其成为澳大利亚饮食的标准组成部分，也无法普遍获得。如今，本土食品与澳大利亚身份的相关性不如羊肉和西番莲，它们最初都是进口的，现在已经归化了。
answer_zh: 澳大利亚本土食材是指原产于该国的食品，克劳的言论对此表示反对，他更强调与“自然”和地理起源的联系，而不是普通用法，但尽管努力促进和鼓励消费本土资源，澳大利亚人并没有大量食用本土食品，因为丛林食品的收获或生产不足，也不易获得，因此本土食品与今天的澳大利亚身份的相关性较小。

question: Orville and Wilbur Wright were brothers living in Dayton, Ohio. The two had started making bicycles during the 1890s and had a successful small business selling their Wright Specials for $18 each ($475 in today’s dollars). This experience with building light, strong machines would prove valuable in the coming years after the brothers’ interest turned to ﬂight. Others in the United States were also developing aircraft at the time the Wright brothers started turning their curiosity skyward. Samuel Langley had ﬂown an unmanned steam-powered aircraft in 1896. Octave Chanute and others were ﬂying gliders near Chicago late in the decade as well. But it wasn’t until the Wright brothers started working on the matter that the “ﬂying problem” would ﬁnally be solved. Beginning in 1899, the brothers designed and built a series of gliders to test their various ideas on a ﬂying machine. They constructed a wind tunnel that allowed them to test designs without having to build a full-size model. They even built their own gasoline-powered motor for their aircraft.
answer: Brothers Orville and Wilbur, who had experience with making bicycles and selling Wright specials before turning interest to ﬂight, ﬁnally solved the “ﬂying problem” in spite of others in the United States such as Samuel Langley and Octave Chanute, who also developed aircraft in 1890s, as the brothers designed and built gliders to test ideas, constructed a wind tunnel to test designs, and even built their own gasoline-powered motor for their aircraft.
question_zh: 奥维尔·赖特和威尔伯·赖特是住在俄亥俄州代顿的兄弟。两人在 1890 年代开始制造自行车，并经营一家成功的小企业，以每辆 18 美元的价格出售 Wright Special（按今天的美元计算为 475 美元）。在兄弟俩的兴趣转向飞行之后，这种制造轻型、坚固机器的经验在接下来的几年中被证明是有价值的。当莱特兄弟开始将好奇心转向天空时，美国的其他人也在开发飞机。塞缪尔·兰利 (Samuel Langley) 于 1896 年驾驶过一架无人驾驶蒸汽动力飞机。奥克塔夫·查努特 (Octave Chanute) 和其他人也在本世纪末在芝加哥附近驾驶过滑翔机。但直到莱特兄弟开始研究这个问题，“飞行问题”才最终得到解决。从 1899 年开始，兄弟俩设计并制造了一系列滑翔机，以在飞行器上测试他们的各种想法。他们建造了一个风洞，使他们能够测试设计，而无需构建全尺寸模型。他们甚至为自己的飞机制造了自己的汽油发动机。
answer_zh: 奥维尔和威尔伯兄弟在对飞行产生兴趣之前，曾拥有制造自行车和销售莱特特产的经验，尽管塞缪尔·兰利和奥克塔夫·查努特等美国其他人也在 1890 年代开发了飞机，但他们最终解决了“飞行问题”，兄弟俩设计和制造了滑翔机来测试想法，建造了一个风洞来测试设计，甚至为他们的飞机建造了自己的汽油发动机。

question: The notion that oﬃce space has a role in promoting or inhibiting performance is backed up by solid research. A recent study conducted by Harvard University and Massachusetts General Hospital showed that improvements to the physical surroundings of workers aﬀected productivity not just because the working environment was more attractive, but because the changes made employees feel cared for. A Swedish research paper revealed a strong link between the type of oﬃce an employee worked in and their overall job satisfaction and health. Various ﬁndings have emerged as a result of studies such as this. Pot plants and greenery can apparently have a real impact on psychological well-being. Those who work in a private room tend to be in better health than workers based in open-plan oﬃces. Suﬃcient light can reduce sickness among workers and increase productivity, and an attractive oﬃce can make workers feel more cared for and therefore more loyal to their company. Most of these points make good rational sense. But some companies aren 't content simply to increase the health, productivity, and contentment of their employees. Pioneers such as Google, Walt Disney, and Dyson have tried to create oﬃces that will do everything from promoting collaboration between workers to stimulating their creative juices. "Environment, both physical and cultural, can make or break creativity ", says Kursty Groves, author of I Wish I Worked There! A look inside the most creative spaces in business. Stimulating spaces expose the mind to a variety of stimuli, planned or random, in order to encourage people to think diﬀerently. Reﬂective spaces promote the ﬁltering of information into the brain slowing it to make connections. An environment that encourages a team to build trust and to play freely is an essential ingredient for innovation.
answer: The beneﬁt of improving oﬃce environment is that a better oﬃce environment, such as a pot of plants in the oﬃce, private oﬃce, and suﬃcient light, can improve employee satisfaction and would motivate staﬀ regarding creativity and innovation, as proven by relevant research.
question_zh: 办公空间在促进或抑制绩效方面发挥作用的观点得到了扎实的研究的支持。哈佛大学和马萨诸塞州总医院最近进行的一项研究表明，员工物质环境的改善会影响生产力，不仅因为工作环境更具吸引力，而且因为这些变化让员工感到受到关心。瑞典的一篇研究论文揭示了员工工作的办公室类型与其整体工作满意度和健康状况之间存在密切联系。诸如此类的研究结果已经出现了各种结果。盆栽植物和绿色植物显然可以对心理健康产生真正的影响。在私人房间工作的人往往比在开放式办公室工作的人健康状况更好。充足的光线可以减少工人的疾病并提高生产力，而有吸引力的办公室可以让工人感到受到更多的关心，从而对公司更加忠诚。其中大多数观点都有很好的理性意义。但一些公司并不满足于仅仅提高员工的健康、生产力和满意度。谷歌、华特迪士尼和戴森等先行者曾试图创建办公室，从促进员工之间的合作到激发他们的创造力，无所不包。 “环境，无论是物质环境还是文化环境，都可以创造或破坏创造力”，《我希望我在那里工作！》一书的作者库斯蒂·格罗夫斯 (Kursty Groves) 说道。深入了解商业中最具创意的空间。刺激空间使大脑受到各种有计划或随机的刺激，以鼓励人们进行不同的思考。反射空间促进信息过滤进入大脑，减缓大脑建立联系的速度。鼓励团队建立信任和自由发挥的环境是创新的重要组成部分。
answer_zh: 改善办公环境的好处在于，更好的办公环境，比如办公室里的一盆植物、私人办公室、充足的光线，可以提高员工的满意度，并能激发员工的创造力和创新性，相关研究也证明了这一点。

question: The world engages in improving the literacy of reading and writing, but it is not that important now. What is a text-written language anyway? It is an accidental IT for storing and retrieving information. We store information by writing it, and we retrieve it by reading it. 6000 to 10,000 years ago, many of our ancestors ' hunter-gatherer societies settled on the land and began what 's known as the agricultural revolution. That new land settlement led to private property and increased production and trade of goods, generating a huge new inﬂux of information. Unable to keep all this in their memories, our ancestors created systems of written records that evolved over millennia into today 's written language.But this ancient IT is already becoming obsolete. The text has run its historical course and is now rapidly getting replaced in every area of our lives by the ever-increasing emerging IT driven by voice, video, and body movement rather than the written word. In my view, this is a positive step forward in the evolution of human technology, and it carries great potential for a total positive redesign of education. Written language is an ancient IT for storing and retrieving information. However, the written word is becoming obsolete and is now rapidly getting replaced by voice, video and body movement, which is believed a positive step forward in the evolution of human technology and redesign of education.
answer: Literacy of reading and writing is not that important now, because the accident IT for storing and retrieving information during agricultural revolution, and creating systems of written records that evolved into today’s written language is obsolete, and text is rapidly getting replaced by the emerging IT driven by voice, video, and body movement rather than written words, which is a positive step forward in human technology as it carries great potential for redesign of education.
question_zh: 世界致力于提高阅读和写作素养，但现在已经不那么重要了。到底什么是文本书写语言？它是一种用于存储和检索信息的偶然IT。我们通过写入来存储信息，并通过读取来检索信息。 6000 到 10,000 年前，我们祖先的许多狩猎采集社会在这片土地上定居并开始了所谓的农业革命。新的土地定居带来了私有财产和商品生产和贸易的增加，产生了大量新的信息涌入。由于无法将这一切保留在记忆中，我们的祖先创造了书面记录系统，并在数千年的时间里演变成今天的书面语言。但这种古老的信息技术已经过时了。文本已经经历了它的历史进程，现在正在我们生活的各个领域迅速被由语音、视频和身体运动而不是书面文字驱动的不断增长的新兴信息技术所取代。在我看来，这是人类技术进化的积极一步，它具有对教育进行全面积极重新设计的巨大潜力。书面语言是一种古老的用于存储和检索信息的信息技术。然而，书面文字正在变得过时，并且正在迅速被语音、视频和身体运动所取代，这被认为是人类技术进化和教育重新设计的积极一步。
answer_zh: 阅读和写作的读写能力现在已经不再那么重要，因为农业革命期间用于存储和检索信息的偶然信息技术，以及创建演变为今天书面语言的书面记录系统的信息技术已经过时，文本正在迅速被由语音、视频和身体运动而不是书面文字驱动的新兴信息技术所取代，这是人类技术向前迈出的积极一步，因为它具有重新设计教育的巨大潜力。

question: What is the solution for nations with increasing energy demands, hindered by frequent power cuts and an inability to compete in the international oil market For East Africa at least, experts think geothermal energy is the answer. More promising still, the Kenyan government and international investors seem to be listening. This is just in time according to many, as claims of an acute energy crisis are afoot due to high oil prices, population spikes, and droughts. Geothermal energy works by pumping water into bedrock, where it is heated and returns to the surface as steam which is used directly as a heat source or to drive electricity production. Source Energy Information Administration, Geothermal Energy in the Western United States and Hawaii. Currently, over 60% of Kenya 's power comes from hydroelectric sources, but these are proving increasingly unreliable as the issue of seasonal variation is intensiﬁed by erratic rain patterns. Alternative energy sources are needed and the leading energy supplier in Kenya, Kenya Electricity Generating Company KenGen, hopes to expand its geothermal energy supply from 13 to 25 of its total usage by 2020. The potential of geothermal energy in the region was ﬁrst realized internationally by the United Nations Development Program when geologists observed thermal anomalies below the East African Rift system. Locals have been utilizing this resource for centuries using steam vents to create the perfect humidity for greenhouses, or simply to enjoy a swim in the many natural hot lakes. Along the 6000 km of the rift from the Red Sea to Mozambique, geochemical, geophysical and heat ﬂow measurements were made to identify areas suitable for geothermal wells. One area lies next to the extinct Olkaria volcano, within the Hells Gate National Park, and sits over some of the thinnest continental crust on Earth. This is a result of the thinning of the crust by tectonic stretching, causing hotter material below the Earths surface to rise, resulting in higher temperatures. This thin crust was ideal for the drilling of geothermal wells, reaching depths of around 3000 meters, where temperatures get up to 342°C, far higher than the usual temperature of 90°C at this depth. Water in the surrounding rocks is converted to steam by the heat. The steam can be used to drive turbines and produce electricity.
answer: Due to the instability of using hydroelectric power, Kenya government plans to exploit geothermal energy to supply 25% of total electricity generated by 2020, and two ideal regions have already been identiﬁed with ideal geological conditions and suitable temperature. (Word count:39)
question_zh: 对于能源需求不断增加、经常停电和无法在国际石油市场竞争的国家来说，解决方案是什么？至少对于东非来说，专家认为地热能就是答案。更有希望的是，肯尼亚政府和国际投资者似乎正在倾听。许多人认为，这一举措来得正是时候，因为高油价、人口激增和干旱正在引发严重的能源危机。地热能的工作原理是将水泵入基岩，水被加热并以蒸汽形式返回地表，直接用作热源或驱动发电。资料来源：能源信息管理局，美国西部和夏威夷的地热能。目前，肯尼亚 60% 以上的电力来自水力发电，但事实证明水力发电越来越不可靠，因为不稳定的降雨模式加剧了季节变化问题。肯尼亚需要替代能源，肯尼亚领先的能源供应商肯尼亚发电公司 KenGen 希望到 2020 年将其地热能供应量从占其总用量的 13 % 扩大到 25 %。当地质学家观察到东非大裂谷系统下方的热异常时，联合国开发计划署首先在国际上认识到该地区地热能的潜力。几个世纪以来，当地人一直在利用这种资源，利用蒸汽喷口为温室创造完美的湿度，或者只是在许多天然热湖中享受游泳的乐趣。沿着从红海到莫桑比克 6000 公里的裂谷，进行了地球化学、地球物理和热流测量，以确定适合开发地热井的区域。其中一个区域位于地狱之门国家公园内的奥尔卡里亚死火山旁边，坐落在地球上最薄的大陆地壳之上。这是由于构造拉伸导致地壳变薄，导致地表以下较热的物质上升，从而导致更高的温度。这种薄薄的地壳非常适合钻探地热井，深度可达 3000 米左右，温度高达 342°C，远高于该深度的通常温度 90°C。周围岩石中的水在热量的作用下转化为蒸汽。蒸汽可用于驱动涡轮机并发电。
answer_zh: 由于水力发电的不稳定，肯尼亚政府计划到2020年利用地热能供应总发电量的25%，并且已经确定了两个地质条件理想、温度适宜的理想地区。 （字数：39）

question: When an individual drives a car, heats a house or uses an aerosol hairspray, greenhouse gases are produced. In economic terms, this creates a classic negative externality. Most of the cost is borne by individuals other than the one making the decision about how many miles to drive or how much hairspray to use. Because the driver or sprayer enjoys all the beneﬁts of the activities but suﬀers only part of the cost, that individual engages in more than the economically eﬃcient amount of the activity. In this sense, the problem of greenhouse gases parallels the problem that occurs when someone smokes a cigarette in an enclosed space or litters the countryside with fast-food wrappers. If we are to get individuals to reduce the production of greenhouse gases to an eﬃcient rate, we must somehow induce them to act as though they bear all the costs of their actions. The two most widely accepted means of doing this are government regulation and taxation, both of which have been proposed to deal with greenhouse gases.
answer: Activities such as driving a car , heating a house , and using hairspray generate greenhouse gases , which form a classic negative externality because people gain all the beneﬁts but bear only part of the costs , leading to excessive and ineﬃcient behavior similar to smoking or littering ; to reduce greenhouse gas emissions eﬀectively , individuals must take full responsibility for their costs , and the two main solutions proposed are government regulation and taxation .
question_zh: 当一个人开车、给房子取暖或使用气雾发胶时，就会产生温室气体。从经济角度来看，这造成了典型的负外部性。大部分成本由个人承担，而不是决定行驶多少英里或使用多少发胶的人承担。由于驾驶员或喷雾器享有活动的所有好处，但只承担部分成本，因此该个人参与的活动超出了经济有效的活动量。从这个意义上说，温室气体问题与某人在封闭空间吸烟或在乡村乱扔快餐包装纸时发生的问题类似。如果我们要让个人有效地减少温室气体的产生，我们必须以某种方式诱导他们采取行动，就好像他们承担了自己行为的所有成本一样。两种最广泛接受的方法是政府监管和税收，这两种方法都被提议用来处理温室气体。
answer_zh: 驾驶汽车、取暖和使用发胶等活动都会产生温室气体，这形成了典型的负外部性，因为人们获得了所有好处，但只承担了部分成本，导致类似于吸烟或乱扔垃圾的过度和低效行为；为了有效减少温室气体排放，个人必须对其成本承担全部责任，提出的两个主要解决方案是政府监管和税收。

question: Here 's how tree-ring dating, known to scientists as dendrochronology works. If you cut a tree down today, it 's straightforward to count the rings inwards, starting from the tree 's outside (corresponding to this year 's growth ring), and thereby to state that the 177th ring from the outermost one towards the center was laid down in the year 2005 minus 177, or 1828. But it 's less straightforward to attach a date to a particular ring in an ancient Anasazi wooden beam because at ﬁrst, you don 't know in what year the beam was cut. However, the widths of tree growth rings vary from year to year, depending on the rain or drought conditions in each year. Hence the sequence of the rings in a tree cross-section is like a message in Morse code formerly used for sending telegraph messages dot-dot-dash-dot-dash in the Morse code, wide-wide-narrow-wide-narrow in the tree ring sequence. Actually, the tree ring sequence is even more diagnostic and richer in information than the Morse code, because trees actually contain rings spanning many diﬀerent widths, rather than the Morse code choice between dot and dash. Tree-ring specialists (known as dendrochronologists) proceed by noting the sequence of wider and narrower rings in a tree cut down in a known recent year, and also noting the sequences in beams from trees cut down at various times in the past. They then match up and align the tree ring sequences with the same diagnostic wide, narrow patterns from diﬀerent beams. In that way, dendrochronologists have constructed tree-ring records extending back for thousands of years in some parts of the world. Each record is valid for a geographic area whose extent depends on local weather patterns because weather and hence tree growth patterns vary with location. For instance, the basic tree-ring chronology of the American Southwest applies (with some variation) to the area from Northern Mexico to Wyoming.
answer: The study of tree rings, which is called dendrochronology, can be used to measure the year when the tree was ﬁrst planted accurately, but unlike Morse code, which can deliver telegraph messages eﬃciently, the information indicated by tree rings is far richer and therefore provides more precise and detailed account of the rain or drought conditions in a particular year.
question_zh: 以下是树木年轮测定法（科学家称为树木年代学）的工作原理。如果你今天砍倒一棵树，很容易从树的外部开始向内数年轮（对应于今年的年轮），从而表明从最外层到中心的第 177 个年轮是在 2005 年减去 177，即 1828 年铺设的。但是在古代阿纳萨齐木梁上的特定年轮上附加日期就不那么简单了，因为首先，你不知道梁是在哪一年被砍断的。然而，树木年轮的宽度每年都有所不同，这取决于每年的降雨或干旱情况。因此，树横截面中的环的序列就像莫尔斯电码中的消息，以前用于发送莫尔斯电码中的电报消息点-点-划-点-划，树环序列中的宽-宽-窄-宽-窄。实际上，树环序列比莫尔斯电码更具诊断性，信息更丰富，因为树实际上包含跨越许多不同宽度的环，而不是点和划之间的莫尔斯电码选择。树木年轮专家（称为树木年代学家）首先记录在已知的最近一年中砍伐的树木中较宽和较窄的年轮的顺序，并记录过去不同时间砍伐的树木的横梁的序列。然后，他们将树木年轮序列与来自不同光束的相同诊断宽窄图案进行匹配和对齐。通过这种方式，树木年代学家在世界某些地区构建了可追溯到数千年前的树木年轮记录。每个记录对于一个地理区域有效，该地理区域的范围取决于当地的天气模式，因为天气以及树木的生长模式随位置而变化。例如，美国西南部的基本树木年轮年表（有一些变化）适用于从墨西哥北部到怀俄明州的地区。
answer_zh: 对树木年轮的研究被称为树木年代学，可以用来准确测量树木首次种植的年份，但与可以有效传递电报信息的莫尔斯电码不同，树木年轮所指示的信息要丰富得多，因此可以更精确和详细地描述特定年份的降雨或干旱情况。

question: For economists in the corporate sector, forecasting is usually a key function, and to do the job the draw upon a wide range of statistical data, But economic forecasting is a long way from a precise science. Forecasters must, after all, start somewhere and their assumptions about how an economy works can vary widely. 'The diﬀerences in beliefs are enormous; so varied and conﬂicting that economics is jokingly said be the only ﬁeld in which two people can get a Nobel Prize for saying exactly the opposite thing, says Wiliam Sherden, author of the highly-regarded The Fortune Sellers. Sherden argues that the record of economic forecasting is rather poor, especially for volatile statis os such as interest rates-althouch they do better for some stable statistics, such as government spending, and about the same for statistics such as real GNP growth and inﬂation.
question_zh: 对于企业部门的经济学家来说，预测通常是一项关键职能，并且要利用广泛的统计数据来完成这项工作，但经济预测距离精确的科学还有很长的路要走。毕竟，预测者必须从某个地方开始，他们对经济如何运作的假设可能会有很大差异。 “信仰上的差异是巨大的；备受推崇的《财富卖家》一书的作者威廉·谢尔登 (Wiliam Sherden) 表示，经济学的观点如此多样且相互冲突，以至于有人开玩笑说，经济学是唯一一个两个人能因为观点完全相反而获得诺贝尔奖的领域。谢尔登认为，经济预测的记录相当糟糕，尤其是对于利率等不稳定的统计数据——尽管它们对于政府支出等一些稳定的统计数据做得更好，对于实际国民生产总值增长和通货膨胀等统计数据也差不多。

question: Spurred by the sense that disorderly behavior among students in South Euclid was increasing, the school resource oﬃcer (SRO) reviewed data regarding referrals to the principal 's oﬃce. He found that the high school reported thousands of referrals a year for bullying and that the junior high school had recently experienced a 30 percent increase in bullying referrals. Police data showed that juvenile complaints about disturbances, bullying, and assaults after school hours had increased by 90 percent in the past ten years. The SRO worked in close collaboration with a social worker and a university researcher. They coordinated a Response Planning Team comprising many stakeholders that were intended to respond to each of the areas identiﬁed in the initial analysis. Environmental changes included modifying the school schedule and increasing teacher supervision of hotspots. Counselors and social workers conducted teacher training courses in conﬂict resolution and bullying prevention. Parent education included mailings with information about bullying, an explanation of the new school policy, and a discussion about what could be done at home to address the problems. Finally, student education included classroom discussions between homeroom teachers and students, as well as assemblies conducted by the SRO. The SRO also opened a substation next to a primary hotspot. The Ohio Department of Education contributed by opening a new training center to provide a non-traditional setting for specialized help. The results from the various responses were dramatic. School suspensions decreased by 40 percent. Bullying incidents dropped 60 percent in the hallways and 80 percent in the gym area. Follow-up surveys indicated that there were positive attitudinal changes among students about bullying and that more students felt conﬁdent that teachers would take action when a problem arose. Teachers indicated that training sessions were helpful and that they were more likely to talk about bullying as a serious issue. Parents responded positively, asking for more information about the problem in future mailings. The overall results suggest that the school environments were not only safer but that early intervention was helping at-risk students succeed in school.
answer: The school resource oﬃcer (SRO) found a rapid increase in bullying referrals among high school and junior high school and a researcher, Ohio, conducted a survey with students and teachers, pointing to primary areas of concern, so they coordinated a Response Planning Team comprising many stakeholders responding to initial analysis, whose dramatic overall results suggest that school environments were not only safer, but early intervention was helping at-risk students succeed in school. (Word count:73)
question_zh: 由于南欧几里得学生的扰乱行为日益增多，学校资源官员 (SRO) 审查了有关转介给校长办公室的数据。他发现，高中每年报告数千起欺凌事件，而初中的欺凌事件最近增加了 30%。警方数据显示，青少年对放学后的骚乱、欺凌和袭击的投诉在过去十年里增加了 90%。 SRO 与一名社会工作者和一名大学研究人员密切合作。他们协调了一个由许多利益相关者组成的响应计划团队，旨在对初始分析中确定的每个领域做出响应。环境变化包括修改学校时间表和加强教师对热点地区的监督。辅导员和社会工作者举办了冲突解决和欺凌预防方面的教师培训课程。家长教育包括发送有关欺凌信息的邮件、对新学校政策的解释，以及讨论在家可以采取哪些措施来解决这些问题。最后，学生教育包括班主任和学生之间的课堂讨论，以及由 SRO 举办的集会。 SRO 还在主要热点旁边开设了一个变电站。俄亥俄州教育部开设了一个新的培训中心，为专业帮助提供非传统环境。各种反应的结果是戏剧性的。学校停课次数减少了 40%。走廊里的欺凌事件减少了 60%，健身房区域的欺凌事件减少了 80%。后续调查表明，学生对欺凌的态度发生了积极的变化，更多的学生相信老师在问题出现时会采取行动。教师们表示，培训课程很有帮助，他们更有可能将欺凌视为一个严重的问题。家长们积极响应，要求在以后的邮件中提供有关该问题的更多信息。总体结果表明，学校环境不仅更安全，而且早期干预有助于高危学生在学校取得成功。
answer_zh: 学校资源官员 (SRO) 发现高中和初中的欺凌转介迅速增加，俄亥俄州的一名研究人员对学生和教师进行了一项调查，指出了主要关注领域，因此他们协调了一个由许多利益相关者组成的响应计划小组，对初步分析做出了回应，其引人注目的总体结果表明，学校环境不仅更安全，而且早期干预正在帮助高危学生在学校取得成功。 （字数：73）

question: The history of marketers seeking the advice of physicists is a short one, but an understanding of the Theory of Resonance may give communications experts the edge. Resonance Theory explains the curious phenomenon of how very small pebbles dropped into a pond can create bigger waves than a large brick. The brick makes a decent splash but its ripples peter out quickly. A tiny pebble dropped into the same pond, followed by another, then another, then another, all timed carefully, will create ripples that build into small waves. As Dr Carlo Contaldi, a physicist at Imperial College London, explains, a small amount of energy committed at just the right intervals - the 'natural frequency ' - creates a cumulatively large eﬀect. Media consultant Paul Bay believes that just as with pebbles in a pond, a carefully choreographed and meticulously timed stream of communication will have a more lasting eﬀect than a sporadic big splash during prime-time TV breaks. So whether you 're trying to make waves in the laboratory or in the media, the people in white coats would advise a little and often. A big budget is not the prerequisite for success.
answer: An understanding of the Theory of Resonance may give communications experts the edge, and Resonance Theory explains the curious phenomenon of how very small pebbles dropped into a pond can create bigger waves than a large brick, so whether you 're trying to make waves in the laboratory or in the media, the people in white coats would advise a little and often, and a big budget is not the prerequisite of success.(72)
question_zh: 营销人员寻求物理学家建议的历史很短，但对共振理论的理解可能会给传播专家带来优势。共振理论解释了一个奇怪的现象，即投入池塘的非常小的卵石可以产生比大砖块更大的波浪。砖块发出了不错的水花，但它的涟漪很快就消失了。将一颗小石子扔进同一个池塘，然后再投下一颗，然后再投下一颗，然后再投下一颗，所有这些都经过仔细的计时，会产生涟漪，形成小波浪。正如伦敦帝国理工学院的物理学家卡洛·康塔尔迪博士所解释的那样，在适当的时间间隔（即“自然频率”）施加少量能量会产生累积的巨大效应。媒体顾问保罗·贝 (Paul Bay) 认为，就像池塘里的鹅卵石一样，精心设计、精心安排的沟通流将比黄金时段电视节目中零星的大轰动产生更持久的影响。因此，无论你想在实验室还是在媒体上引起轰动，穿白大褂的人都会经常提供一些建议。大预算并不是成功的先决条件。
answer_zh: 对共振理论的理解可能会给通信专家带来优势，共振理论解释了一个奇怪的现象，即扔进池塘的非常小的卵石可以比一块大砖块产生更大的波浪，因此无论你想在实验室还是在媒体上掀起波澜，穿白大褂的人都会经常提供一些建议，而大预算并不是成功的先决条件。(72)

question: Human remains are a fundamental part of the archaeological record, oﬀering unique insights into the lives of individuals and populations in the past. Like many archaeological materials, human remains require distinctive and specialized methods of recovery, analysis, and interpretation, while technological innovations and the accumulation of expertise have enabled archaeologists to extract ever greater amounts of information from assemblages of skeletal material. Alongside analyses of new ﬁnds, these advances have consistently thrown new light on existing collections of human remains in museums, universities and other institutions. Given the powerful emotional, social and religious meanings attached to the dead body, it is perhaps unsurprising that human remains pose a distinctive set of ethical questions for archaeologists. With the rise of indigenous rights movements and the emergence of post-colonial nations, the acquisition and ownership of human remains became a divisive and politically loaded issue. It became increasingly clear that many human remains in museum collections around the world represented the traces of colonial exploitation and discredited pseudo-scientiﬁc theories of race. In the light of these debates and changing attitudes, some human remains were returned or repatriated to their communities of origin, a process that continues to this day. Recently a new set of challenges to the study of human remains has emerged from a rather unexpected direction: the British government revised its interpretation of nineteenth-century burial legislation in a way that would drastically curtail the ability of archaeologists to study human remains of any age excavated in England and Wales. This paper examines these extraordinary events and the legal, political and ethical questions that they raise.
answer: Advances in technology enable archaeologists to fully explore human remains which contain rich information about people and their lifestyle in the past, but due to ethical dilemma arising from the study and the issue of ownership, some human remains were returned to their original communities, with the British government unexpectedly tightening its policy regarding the accessibility of human remains.
question_zh: 人类遗骸是考古记录的基本组成部分，为了解过去个人和人群的生活提供了独特的见解。与许多考古材料一样，人类遗骸需要独特且专门的恢复、分析和解释方法，而技术创新和专业知识的积累使考古学家能够从骨骼材料组合中提取更多信息。除了对新发现的分析之外，这些进步不断为博物馆、大学和其他机构中现有的人类遗骸收藏提供新的线索。鉴于尸体具有强大的情感、社会和宗教意义，人类遗骸给考古学家带来了一系列独特的伦理问题，这也许并不奇怪。随着原住民权利运动的兴起和后殖民国家的出现，人类遗骸的获取和所有权成为一个引起分歧和政治负担的问题。越来越明显的是，世界各地博物馆收藏的许多人类遗骸代表了殖民剥削的痕迹和令人怀疑的伪科学种族理论。鉴于这些辩论和态度的变化，一些遗骸被送回或遣返其原籍社区，这一过程一直持续到今天。最近，人类遗骸研究面临的一系列新挑战来自一个相当意想不到的方向：英国政府修改了对十九世纪埋葬立法的解释，这将大大削弱考古学家研究在英格兰和威尔士出土的任何年龄的人类遗骸的能力。本文探讨了这些非同寻常的事件以及它们引发的法律、政治和道德问题。
answer_zh: 技术的进步使考古学家能够充分发掘包含了过去人们及其生活方式的丰富信息的人类遗骸，但由于研究中出现的伦理困境和所有权问题，一些人类遗骸被送回了原来的社区，而英国政府意外地收紧了对人类遗骸获取的政策。

question: We live in an aging world. While this has been recognized for some time in developed countries, it is only recently that this phenomenon has been fully acknowledged. Global communication is "shrinking " the world, and global aging is "maturing " it. The increasing presence of older persons in the world is making people of all ages more aware that we live in a diverse and multigenerational society. It is no longer possible to ignore aging, regardless of whether one views it positively or negatively. Demographers note that if current trends in aging continue as predicted, a demographic revolution, wherein the proportions of the young and the old will undergo a historic crossover, will be felt in just three generations. This portrait of change in the world 's population parallels the magnitude of the industrial revolution traditionally considered the most signiﬁcant social and economic breakthrough in the history of humankind since the Neolithic period. It marked the beginning of a sustained movement towards modern economic growth in much the same way that globalization is today marking an unprecedented and sustained movement toward a "global culture ". The demographic revolution, it is envisaged, will be at least as powerful. While the future eﬀects are not known, a likely scenario is one where both the challenges as well as the opportunities will emerge from a vessel into which exploration and research, dialogue and debate are poured. Challenges arise as social and economic structures try to adjust to the simultaneous phenomenon of diminishing young cohorts with rising older ones, and opportunities present themselves in the sheer number of older individuals and the vast resources societies stand to gain from their contribution.
answer: The phenomenon of aging world is a demographic revolution, wherein it is a diverse and multi-generational society, and proportions of the old will surpass the young, and it is as important as the Industrial Revolution and globalization, and it is a challenge as well as an opportunity and will have a profound inﬂuence on all social, economic and cultural spheres.
question_zh: 我们生活在一个老龄化的世界。虽然发达国家早已认识到这一点，但直到最近才充分认识到这一现象。全球通讯正在使世界“缩小”，而全球老龄化正在使世界“成熟”。世界上老年人的数量不断增加，使各个年龄段的人们更加意识到我们生活在一个多元化、多代人的社会。无论人们对衰老的看法是积极的还是消极的，我们都不再可能忽视衰老。人口统计学家指出，如果目前的老龄化趋势如预测的那样持续下去，那么在短短三代人的时间内就会感受到一场人口革命，其中年轻人和老年人的比例将经历历史性的交叉。这种世界人口变化的描述与工业革命的规模相呼应，工业革命传统上被认为是自新石器时代以来人类历史上最重大的社会和经济突破。它标志着现代经济增长持续运动的开始，就像今天的全球化标志着一场前所未有的、持续的“全球文化”运动一样。据设想，人口革命至少将具有同样强大的力量。虽然未来的影响尚不清楚，但一种可能的情况是，挑战和机遇都将从一艘充满探索和研究、对话和辩论的船上出现。当社会和经济结构试图适应年轻群体减少和老年人群体增加的同时现象时，挑战就出现了，而老年人口的绝对数量和社会将从他们的贡献中获得的大量资源带来了机遇。
answer_zh: 世界老龄化现象是一场人口革命，是一个多元化、多代际的社会，老年人口比例将超过年轻人口，其重要性与工业革命和全球化同等重要，既是挑战，也是机遇，将对社会、经济、文化各领域产生深远影响。

question: This paper highlights that travel and tourism generates, directly and indirectly, a large percentage of GDP and a huge number of jobs in the worldwide economy, which can be expected to continue to grow. Jobs generated by travel and tourism are spread across the economy, employ a large proportion of women, minority groups and young people, and oﬀer good training transferability. There are numerous good examples of tourism acting as a catalyst for conservation and improvement of the environment and maintenance of local diversity and culture. Tourism has a comparative advantage in that its start-up and running costs can be low compared to many other forms of industry development.
question_zh: 本文强调，旅行和旅游业直接和间接地创造了全球经济中很大一部分的国内生产总值和大量就业机会，预计全球经济将继续增长。旅行和旅游业产生的就业机会遍布整个经济领域，雇用了大量妇女、少数群体和年轻人，并提供良好的培训可转移性。有许多旅游业作为保护和改善环境以及维护当地多样性和文化的催化剂的良好例子。旅游业的比较优势在于，与许多其他形式的产业发展相比，其启动和运营成本较低。

question: When Australians engage in debate about educational quality or equity, they often seem to accept that a country cannot achieve both at the same time. Curriculum reforms intended to improve equity often fail to do so because they increase breadth or diﬀerentiation in oﬀerings in a way that increases diﬀerences in quality. Further, these diﬀerences in quality often reﬂect diﬀerences in student 's social backgrounds because the new oﬀerings are typically taken up by relatively disadvantaged students who are not served well them. Evidence from New South Wales will be used to illustrate this point. The need to improve the quality of education is well accepted across OECD and other countries as they seek to strengthen their human capital to underpin their modern, knowledge economies. Improved equity is also important for this purpose since the demand for high-level skills is widespread and the opportunities for the low - skilled are diminishing. Improved equity in education is also important for social cohesion. There are countries in which the education system seems primarily to reproduce existing social arrangements, conferring privilege where it already exists and denying it where it does not. Even in countries where the diagnosis might be less extreme, the capacity of schooling to build social cohesion is often diminished by the way in which schools separate individuals and groups.
answer: There is a need to improve quality and equity as to strengthen human capital to underpin modern, knowledge economies, and improved equity in education is also important for social cohesion, but Australians often seem to accept that a country cannot achieve both educational quality and equity concurrently because they increase breadth or diﬀerentiation in oﬀerings in a way that increases diﬀerences in quality.
question_zh: 当澳大利亚人参与有关教育质量或公平的辩论时，他们似乎常常承认一个国家无法同时实现两者。旨在改善公平的课程改革往往无法实现这一目标，因为它们以增加质量差异的方式增加了课程的广度或差异。此外，这些质量上的差异往往反映了学生社会背景的差异，因为新课程通常是由相对弱势的学生选择的，他们得不到很好的服务。新南威尔士州的证据将用来说明这一点。提高教育质量的必要性已被经合组织和其他国家广泛接受，因为它们寻求加强人力资本以支撑现代知识经济。为此，提高公平性也很重要，因为对高水平技能的需求广泛，而低技能者的机会正在减少。改善教育公平对于社会凝聚力也很重要。在有些国家，教育制度似乎主要是复制现有的社会安排，在已经存在的地方授予特权，在不存在的地方否认特权。即使在诊断可能不那么极端的国家，学校教育建立社会凝聚力的能力也常常因学校将个人和群体分开的方式而减弱。
answer_zh: 有必要提高质量和公平性，以加强人力资本来支撑现代知识经济，而提高教育公平性对于社会凝聚力也很重要，但澳大利亚人似乎常常认为，一个国家无法同时实现教育质量和公平性，因为他们以增加质量差异的方式增加了教育服务的广度或差异性。

question: Considering the current situation like their counterparts in the United States, engineers, and technicians in India have the capacity to provide both computer programming and innovative new technologies. Indian programmers and high-tech engineers earn one-quarter of what their counterparts earn in the United States, Consequently, India is able to do both jobs at a lower dollar cost than the United States India has an absolute advantage in both. In other words, it can produce a unit of programming for fewer dollars than the United States, and it can also produce a unit of technology innovation for fewer dollars. Does that mean that the United States will lose not only programming jobs but innovative technology jobs, too? Does that mean that our standard of living will fall if the United States and India engage in international trade? David Ricardo would have answered no to both questions- as we do today. While India may have an absolute advantage in both activities, that fact is irrelevant in determining what India or the United States will produce. India has a comparative advantage in doing programming in part because such activity requires little physical capital. The ﬂip side is that the United States has a comparative advantage in technology innovation partly because it is relatively easy to obtain capital in this country to undertake such long-run projects. The result is that Indian programmers will do more and more of what U.S. programmers have been doing in the past. In contrast, American ﬁrms will shift to more and more innovation.
answer: What causes the diﬀerences between computer technicians from the U.S and India is that Indian seems to have the absolutely competitive advantage and same capability with three quarter fewer labor costs, but this fact will not aﬀect the kind of products generated because it is relatively easier to obtain capital in the United States and American ﬁrms will shift to more and more innovation.
question_zh: 考虑到与美国同行一样的现状，印度的工程师和技术人员有能力提供计算机编程和创新新技术。印度程序员和高科技工程师的收入是美国同行的四分之一，因此，印度能够以比美国更低的美元成本完成这两项工作，印度在这两方面都具有绝对优势。换句话说，它可以用比美国更少的美元生产一个单位的编程，也可以用比美国更少的美元生产一个单位的技术创新。这是否意味着美国不仅会失去编程工作，还会失去创新技术工作？这是否意味着如果美国和印度从事国际贸易，我们的生活水平就会下降？大卫·李嘉图对这两个问题的回答都是“否”——就像我们今天所做的那样。尽管印度可能在这两项活动中都拥有绝对优势，但这一事实与决定印度或美国将生产什么无关。印度在编程方面具有比较优势，部分原因是此类活动需要很少的实物资本。另一方面，美国在技术创新方面具有比较优势，部分原因是在该国相对容易获得资本来开展此类长期项目。结果是，印度程序员将越来越多地做美国程序员过去所做的事情。相比之下，美国企业将转向越来越多的创新。
answer_zh: 造成美国和印度计算机技术人员差异的原因在于，印度似乎拥有绝对的竞争优势和相同的能力，但劳动力成本却低四分之三，但这不会影响产品的种类，因为在美国获得资本相对容易，美国企业将转向越来越多的创新。

question: All non-human animals are constrained by the tools that nature has bequeathed them through natural selection. They are not capable of striving towards truth they simply absorb information and behave in ways useful for their survival. The kinds of knowledge they require of the world have been largely pre-selected by evolution. No animal is capable of asking questions or generating problems that are irrelevant to its immediate circumstances or its evolutionarily designed needs. When a beaver builds a dam, it doesn 't ask itself why it does so, or whether there is a better way of doing it. When a swallow ﬂies south, it doesn 't wonder why it is hotter in Africa or what would happen if it ﬂew still further south. Humans do ask themselves these and many other kinds of questions, questions that have no relevance and , indeed make little sense, in the context of evolved needs and goals. What marks out humans is our capacity to go beyond our naturally deﬁned goals such as the need to ﬁnd food, shelter, or a mate ,and to establish humanly created goals. Some contemporary thinkers believe that there are indeed certain questions that humans are incapable of answering because of our evolved nature. Steven Pinker, for instance, argues that "Our minds evolved by natural selection to solve problems that were life and death matters to our ancestors, not to commune with correctness or to answer any question we are capable of asking. We cannot hold ten thousand words in our short-term memory. We cannot see the ultraviolet light. We cannot mentally rotate an object in the fourth dimension. And perhaps we cannot solve conundrums like free will and sentience. "
answer: Non-human animals are unable to ask questions or generate problems that are irrelevant to their immediate circumstances or evolutionarily designed needs such as beaver and swallow, but humans ask questions without relevance related to needs and goals and have the capacity to set up human-created goals above naturally deﬁned goals.
question_zh: 所有非人类动物都受到大自然通过自然选择留给它们的工具的限制。他们没有能力追求真理，他们只是吸收信息并以对他们的生存有用的方式行事。他们所需要的世界知识种类很大程度上是通过进化预先选择的。没有动物能够提出与其当前环境或进化设计的需求无关的问题或产生问题。当海狸建造水坝时，它不会问自己为什么这样做，或者是否有更好的方法。当燕子向南飞时，它不会想知道为什么非洲更热，或者如果它再向南飞会发生什么。人类确实会问自己这些问题和许多其他类型的问题，这些问题与不断发展的需求和目标无关，而且实际上毫无意义。人类的标志是我们有能力超越自然定义的目标，例如寻找食物、住所或伴侣的需要，并建立人为设定的目标。一些当代思想家认为，由于我们进化的本质，人类确实无法回答某些问题。例如，史蒂文·平克（Steven Pinker）认为，“我们的思维是通过自然选择进化来解决对我们祖先来说至关重要的生死攸关的问题，而不是与正确性进行交流或回答我们能够提出的任何问题。我们的短期记忆无法容纳一万个单词。我们看不到紫外线。我们无法在第四维度中在精神上旋转物体。也许我们无法解决自由意志和感知之类的难题。”
answer_zh: 非人类动物无法提出与其当前环境或进化设计的需求无关的问题或产生问题，例如海狸和燕子，但人类提出与需求和目标无关的问题，并且有能力在自然定义的目标之上设定人类创造的目标。

question: At around 2300 BP (Before Present), hunter-gatherers called the San acquired domestic stock in what is now modern-day Botswana. Their population grew and spread throughout the Western half of South Africa. They were the ﬁrst pastoralists in southern Africa, and called themselves Khoikhoi (or Khoe), which means 'men of men ' or 'the real people '. This name was chosen to show pride in their past and culture. The Khoikhoi brought a new way of life to South Africa and to the San, who were hunter-gatherers as opposed to herders. This led to misunderstandings and subsequent conﬂict between the two groups. The Khoikhoi were the ﬁrst native people to come into contact with the Dutch settlers in the mid-17th century. As the Dutch took over land for farms, the Khoikhoi were dispossessed, exterminated, or enslaved and therefore their numbers dwindled. The Khoikhoi were called the Hottentots by European settlers because the sound of their language was so diﬀerent from any European language, and they could not pronounce many of the words and sounds.
answer: The Khoikhoi were the ﬁrst pastoralists in southern Africa, and they brought a new way of life to South Africa and to the San, and they were the ﬁrst native people to come into contact with the Dutch settlers in the mid 17th century, but their language was so diﬀerent from any European language, and they were dispossessed, exterminated or enslaved, so their numbers dwindled.
question_zh: 距今 2300 年左右（现在），狩猎采集者桑人在现在的博茨瓦纳境内获得了国内种群。他们的人口不断增长并遍布南非西半部。他们是南部非洲的第一批牧民，称自己为科伊科伊人（或 Khoe），意思是“男人中的男人”或“真正的人民”。选择这个名字是为了表达对他们的过去和文化的自豪感。科伊科伊人给南非和桑人带来了新的生活方式，桑人是狩猎采集者，而不是牧民。这导致了两个群体之间的误解和随后的冲突。科伊科伊人是 17 世纪中叶第一批与荷兰殖民者接触的原住民。随着荷兰人接管土地用于农场，科伊科伊人被剥夺、灭绝或奴役，因此他们的人数减少了。科伊科伊人被欧洲定居者称为霍屯督人，因为他们的语言发音与任何欧洲语言都大不相同，而且他们无法发音许多单词和发音。
answer_zh: 科伊科伊人是南部非洲最早的游牧民族，他们给南非和桑人带来了新的生活方式，他们是 17 世纪中叶第一批与荷兰殖民者接触的原住民，但他们的语言与任何欧洲语言都大不相同，他们被剥夺、灭绝或奴役，因此人数不断减少。

question: In 1920, the Eighteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution was enacted, creating yet another serious setback to the American wine industry. The National Prohibition Act, also known as the Volstead Act, prohibited the manufacture, sale, transportation, importation, exportation, delivery, or possession of intoxicating liquors for beverage purposes, and nearly destroyed what had become a thriving national industry. In 1920 there were more than seven hundred wineries in California. By the end of Prohibition, there were 160. If Prohibition had lasted only four or ﬁve years, its impact on the wine industry might have been negligible. But it continued for thirteen years, during which time grapes went underground literally and ﬁguratively, becoming an important commodity in the criminal economy. The fruit juice, which was sometimes made into concentrate, was ideal for making wine. Some of this yield found its way to bootleggers throughout America who did just that. But not for long, because the government stepped in and banned the sale of grape juice, preventing illegal wine production. Vineyards stopped being planted, and the American wine industry ground to a halt.
answer: In 1920, the Eighteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution was enacted, creating yet another serious setback to the American wine industry, but it continued for thirteen years, during which time grapes went underground literally and ﬁguratively, becoming an important commodity in the criminal economy, because the government stepped in and banned the sale of grape juice,preventing illegal wine production, and vineyards stopped being planted, and the American wine industry ground to a halt.
question_zh: 1920年，美国宪法第十八修正案的颁布，给美国葡萄酒业带来了又一次严重的挫折。 《国家禁酒法》，也称为《沃尔斯特德法》，禁止制造、销售、运输、进口、出口、交付或拥有用于饮料目的的醉酒，几乎摧毁了这个蓬勃发展的国家产业。 1920年，加州有七百多家酿酒厂。到禁酒令结束时，已经有 160 个。如果禁酒令只持续四五年，它对葡萄酒行业的影响可能可以忽略不计。但这种情况持续了十三年，在此期间，葡萄实际上和象征性地转入地下，成为犯罪经济中的重要商品。果汁有时被制成浓缩液，是酿酒的理想选择。其中一些收益流向了美国各地的走私者，他们就是这样做的。但好景不长，因为政府介入并禁止销售葡萄汁，防止非法葡萄酒生产。葡萄园停止种植，美国葡萄酒业陷入停滞。
answer_zh: 1920年，美国宪法第十八修正案的颁布，给美国葡萄酒业带来了又一次严重的挫折，但这种情况持续了十三年，在此期间，葡萄名副其实地转入地下，成为犯罪经济中的重要商品，因为政府介入并禁止销售葡萄汁，防止非法葡萄酒生产，葡萄园停止种植，美国葡萄酒业陷入停滞。

question: According to new research, house mice (Mus musculus) are ideal biomarkers of human settlement as they tend to stow away in crates or on ships that end up going where people go. Using mice as a proxy for human movement can add to what is already known through archaeological data and answer important questions in areas where there is a lack of artifacts, Searle said. Where people go, so do mice, often stowing away in carts of hay or on ships. Despite a natural range of just 100 meters (109 yards) and an evolutionary base near Pakistan, the house mouse has managed to colonize every continent, which makes it a useful tool for researchers like Searle. Previous research conducted by Searle at the University of York supported the theory that Australian mice originated in the British Isles and probably came over with convicts shipped there to colonize the continent in the late 18th and 19th centuries. In the Viking study, he and his fellow researchers in Iceland, Denmark and Sweden took it a step further, using ancient mouse DNA collected from archaeological sites dating from the 10th to 12th centuries, as well as modern mice. He is hoping to do just that in his next project, which involves tracking the migration of mice and other species, including plants, across the Indian Ocean, from South Asia to East Africa.
answer: In recent research, it has been signiﬁcantly proved that house mice are ideal biomarkers of human settlement and they can be used as a proxy for human movement as supported by Searle’s Viking study on diﬀerent locations, and he is also planning to use his ﬁndings for his next project.
question_zh: 根据新的研究，家鼠（Mus musculus）是人类居住的理想生物标志物，因为它们倾向于藏在板条箱或船上，最终到达人们去的地方。塞尔说，使用老鼠作为人类运动的代表可以增加考古数据已知的知识，并回答缺乏文物的地区的重要问题。人们走到哪里，老鼠就到哪里，它们经常藏在干草车或船上。尽管家鼠的自然活动范围只有 100 米（109 码）且进化基地位于巴基斯坦附近，但它却成功地在各个大陆上定居，这使其成为塞尔等研究人员的有用工具。约克大学塞尔之前进行的研究支持了这样一种理论，即澳大利亚老鼠起源于不列颠群岛，可能在 18 世纪末和 19 世纪随着囚犯被运到那里，在这片大陆上殖民。在维京人的研究中，他和冰岛、丹麦和瑞典的研究人员更进一步，使用了从 10 世纪至 12 世纪考古遗址收集的古代老鼠 DNA 以及现代老鼠。他希望在下一个项目中做到这一点，该项目涉及追踪老鼠和其他物种（包括植物）跨越印度洋，从南亚到东非的迁徙。
answer_zh: 最近的研究已显着证明，家鼠是人类居住的理想生物标志物，它们可以用作人类运动的代表，这得到了塞尔在不同地点进行的维京研究的支持，他还计划将他的发现用于他的下一个项目。

question: Could midday napping save your life? If the experience of Greek men is any guide, the answer may just be yes. In a study released yesterday, researchers at the Harvard School of Public Health and in Athens reported that Greeks who took regular 30-minute siestas were 37 percent less likely to die of heart disease over six years than those who never napped. The scientists tracked more than 23,000 adults, ﬁnding that the beneﬁts of napping were most pronounced for workers. Researchers have long recognized that Mediterranean adults die of heart disease at a rate lower than Americans and Northern Europeans. Diets rich in olive oil and other heart-healthy foods have received some of the credit, but scientists have been intrigued by the potential role of napping. The study, published in the Archives of Internal Medicine, concluded that napping was more likely than diet or physical activity to lower the incidence of heart attacks and other life-ending heart ailments. Still, the authors cautioned that further research is needed to conﬁrm their ﬁndings.
answer: A study by Harvard and Athens researchers found Greek adults who took regular 30-minute midday naps were 37% less likely to die of heart disease over six years, with greater beneﬁts for workers; while Mediterranean low heart disease rates were often linked to diet, this study suggested napping may be more eﬀective than diet or physical activity, though researchers warned further conﬁrmation was needed.
question_zh: 午睡能救你的命吗？如果希腊人的经验有任何指导意义的话，答案可能是肯定的。在昨天发布的一项研究中，哈佛大学公共卫生学院和雅典的研究人员报告称，经常午睡 30 分钟的希腊人在六年内死于心脏病的可能性比那些从不午睡的人低 37%。科学家对 23,000 多名成年人进行了跟踪调查，发现午睡的好处对上班族来说最为明显。研究人员早就认识到，地中海成年人死于心脏病的比率低于美国人和北欧人。富含橄榄油和其他有益心脏健康的食物的饮食得到了一些认可，但科学家们对小睡的潜在作用很感兴趣。这项发表在《内科医学档案》上的研究得出的结论是，小睡比节食或体力活动更有可能降低心脏病和其他致命心脏病的发病率。尽管如此，作者警告说，需要进一步的研究来证实他们的发现。
answer_zh: 哈佛大学和雅典研究人员的一项研究发现，经常午睡 30 分钟的希腊成年人在六年内死于心脏病的可能性降低了 37%，这对工人来说有更大的好处；虽然地中海地区心脏病的低发病率通常与饮食有关，但这项研究表明，午睡可能比饮食或体力活动更有效，但研究人员警告称，还需要进一步证实。

question: I knew it was a good idea because I had been there before. Born and reared on a farm I had been seduced for a few years by the idea of being a big shot who lived and worked in a city rather than only going for the day to wave at the buses. True, I was familiar with some of the minor disadvantages of country living such as an iﬀy private water supply sometimes inﬁltrated by a range of ﬂora and fauna-including, on one memorable occasion, a dead lamb, the absence of central heating in farmhouses and cottages, and a single-track farm road easily blocked by snow, broken-down machinery or escaped livestock. But there were many advantages as I told Liz back in the mid-Seventies. Town born and bred, eight months pregnant and exchanging a warm, substantial Corstorphine terrace for a windswept farm cottage on a much lower income, persuading her that country had it over town might have been diﬃcult.
answer: Although I was seduced by the idea that being a big shot who lived and worked in a city rather than waving at the buses, and familiar with minor disadvantages of country living such as an iﬀy private water supply sometimes inﬁltrated by a range of ﬂora and fauna, there were many advantages as I told Liz back in the mid-Seventies that persuaded her country had it over town might have been diﬃcult.
question_zh: 我知道这是个好主意，因为我以前去过那里。我在农场出生和长大，几年来，我一直被一个想法所诱惑，那就是成为一个在城市生活和工作的大人物，而不是只在公共汽车上挥手致意。确实，我熟悉乡村生活的一些小缺点，例如不稳定的私人供水系统，有时会被一系列动植物渗透——其中包括，在一次令人难忘的事件中，一只死羔羊，农舍和小屋没有中央供暖系统，单轨农场道路很容易被雪、损坏的机械或逃逸的牲畜堵塞。但正如我在七十年代中期告诉莉兹的那样，它有很多优点。在城镇出生和长大，怀孕八个月，用低得多的收入将温暖、坚固的科斯托芬露台换成了风吹草动的农舍，这让她相信乡村比城镇可能会更困难。
answer_zh: 尽管我被这样的想法所吸引：作为一个在城市生活和工作的大人物，而不是在公共汽车上挥手致意，并且熟悉乡村生活的一些小缺点，例如不稳定的私人供水系统，有时会被各种动植物渗透，但正如我在七十年代中期告诉莉兹的那样，有很多优点，说服她的国家拥有它而不是城镇可能很困难。

question: Parents ' own birth order can become an issue when dynamics in the family they are raising replicate the family in which they were raised. Agati notes common examples, such as a ﬁrstborn parent getting into "raging battles " with a ﬁrstborn child. "Both are used to getting the last word. Each has to be right. But the parent has to be the grown-up and step out of that battle, " he advises. When youngest children become parents, Agati cautions that because they "may not have had high expectations placed on them, they, in turn, may not see their kids for their abilities. " But he also notes that since youngest children tend to be more social, "youngest parents can be helpful to their ﬁrstborn, who may have a harder time with social situations. These parents can help their eldest kids loosen up and not be so hard on themselves. Mom Susan Ritz says her own birth order didn 't seem to aﬀect her parenting until the youngest of her three children, Julie, was born. Julie was nine years younger than Ritz 's oldest, Joshua, mirroring the age diﬀerence between Susan and her own older brother. "I would see Joshua do to Julie what my brother did to me, " she says of the taunting and teasing by a much older sibling. "I had to try not to always take Julie 's side. " Biases can surface no matter what your own birth position was, as Lori Silverstone points out. "As a middle myself, I can be harder on my older daughter. I recall my older sister hitting me, " she says of her reactions to her daughters' tussles.
answer: Parents’ own birth order can inﬂuence the family they are raising; for example, when youngest children become parents, they may not see their children’s ability and they can help their ﬁrstborn to solve various problems, but biases exist no matter what parents’ own birth order is.
question_zh: 当父母所养育的家庭中的动态与他们长大的家庭重复时，他们自己的出生顺序可能会成为一个问题。阿加蒂指出了常见的例子，例如长子父母与长子发生“激烈的战斗”。 “双方都习惯了做出最后决定。每个人都必须是正确的。但父母必须是成年人，走出这场战斗，”他建议道。当最小的孩子成为父母时，阿加蒂警告说，因为他们“可能没有对他们抱有很高的期望，反过来，他们也可能看不到孩子的能力。”但他也指出，由于最小的孩子往往更善于社交，“最小的父母可以帮助他们的长子，因为他们在社交场合可能会遇到困难。这些父母可以帮助他们最大的孩子放松下来，而不是对自己太严厉。妈妈苏珊·里茨说，她自己的出生顺序似乎并没有改变。”直到她三个孩子中最小的朱莉出生，朱莉比里兹最大的孩子约书亚小九岁，这反映了苏珊和她哥哥之间的年龄差异。“我会看到约书亚对朱莉做我哥哥对我所做的事情，”她在谈到一个比她大得多的兄弟姐妹的嘲笑和戏弄时说道。正如洛里·希尔维斯通 (Lori Silverstone) 指出的那样，无论你的出生位置如何，偏见都会浮现出来。“作为中间人，我可能会对我的大女儿更严厉。我记得我姐姐打了我，”她谈到她对女儿们打架的反应时说道。
answer_zh: 父母自己的出生顺序会影响他们养育的家庭；例如，当最小的孩子成为父母时，他们可能看不到孩子的能力，他们可以帮助长子解决各种问题，但无论父母自己的出生顺序是什么，偏见都存在。

question: Males do the singing and females do the listening. This has been the established, even cherished view of courtship in birds, but now some ornithologists are changing the tune. Lszl Garamszegi of the University of Antwerp, Belgium, and colleagues studied the literature on 233 European songbird species. Of the 109 for which information on females was available, they found evidence for singing in 101 species. In only eight species could the team conclude that females did not sing? Females that sing have been overlooked, the team says, because their songs are quiet, they are mistaken for males from their similar plumage, or they live in less well-studied areas such as the tropics. Garamszegi blames Charles Darwin for the oversight. He emphasized the importance of male sexual display, and this is what everyone has been looking at. The ﬁndings go beyond modern species. After carefully tracing back an evolutionary family tree for their songbirds, the Garamszegis team discovered that, in at least two bird families, singing evolved in females ﬁrst. They suggest these ancient females may have been using their songs to deter other females from their territories, to coordinate breeding activities with males, or possibly to attract mates.
answer: Ornithologists changed their pervious view and claimed that females that sing had been overlooked, and it is because that either their songs are quiet or they live in tropics, however, after tracing back an evolutionary family tree for songbirds, there is no answer for why some females to give up singing.
question_zh: 男性负责唱歌，女性负责聆听。这一直是鸟类求偶的既定观点，甚至受到珍视，但现在一些鸟类学家正在改变这种观点。比利时安特卫普大学的 Lszl Garamszegi 及其同事研究了有关 233 种欧洲鸣禽的文献。在可获得有关雌性信息的 109 个物种中，他们发现了 101 个物种会唱歌的证据。研究小组只能在八个物种中得出结论，雌性不会唱歌？研究小组表示，唱歌的雌性被忽视了，因为它们的歌声很安静，由于羽毛相似，它们被误认为是雄性，或者它们生活在热带等研究较少的地区。加拉姆塞吉指责查尔斯·达尔文的疏忽。他强调了男性性展示的重要性，这也是大家一直在关注的。这些发现超越了现代物种。在仔细追溯鸣禽的进化谱系树后，加拉姆塞吉斯团队发现，至少在两个鸟类家族中，雌性首先进化出歌唱能力。他们认为，这些古老的雌性可能一直在利用它们的歌曲来阻止其他雌性进入它们的领地，协调与雄性的繁殖活动，或者可能是为了吸引配偶。
answer_zh: 鸟类学家改变了以往的观点，声称雌性唱歌被忽视了，要么是因为它们的歌声很安静，要么是因为它们生活在热带地区，但在追溯鸣禽的进化谱系后，并没有找到为什么有些雌性放弃唱歌的原因。

question: The co-evolutionary relationship between cows and grass is one of nature’s underappreciated wonders; it also happens to be the key to understanding just about everything about modern meat. For the grasses, which have evolved to withstand the grazing of ruminants, the cow maintains and expands their habitat by preventing trees and shrubs from gaining a foothold and hogging the sunlight; the animal also spreads grass seed, plants it with his hooves, and then fertilizes it with his manure. In exchange for these services, the grasses oﬀer ruminants a plentiful and exclusive supply of lunch. Cows (like sheep, bison, and other ruminants) have evolved the special ability to convert grass – which single- stomached creatures like us can’t digest – into high-quality protein. They can do this because they possess what is surely the most highly evolved digestive organ in nature: the rumen. About the size of a medicine ball, the organ is essentially a forty-ﬁve-gallon fermentation tank in which a resident population of bacteria dines on grass. Living their unseen lives at the far end of the food chain that culminates in a hamburger, these bacteria have, just like the grasses, coevolved with the cow, whom they feed. Truly this is an excellent system for all concerned: for the grasses, for the bacteria, for the animals, and for us, the animals’ eaters.
answer: Cows and grasses form mutually beneﬁcial relationships: cows can only survive by eating grass, whereas this process can help the grass to expand, spread and fertilize its seeds and the transformation from grass to the protein inside a cow’s body is highly dependent upon rumen which is huge in both size and its capacity.
question_zh: 牛和草之间的共同进化关系是未被充分认识的大自然奇迹之一。它也恰好是理解现代肉类的一切的关键。对于已经进化到可以承受反刍动物吃草的草来说，牛通过阻止树木和灌木立足并霸占阳光来维持和扩大它们的栖息地；动物还撒播草籽，用蹄子种植，然后用粪便施肥。作为这些服务的交换，草丛为反刍动物提供了丰富而独特的午餐。牛（如绵羊、野牛和其他反刍动物）已经进化出了将草（像我们这样的单胃生物无法消化的草）转化为高质量蛋白质的特殊能力。它们之所以能做到这一点，是因为它们拥有自然界中进化程度最高的消化器官：瘤胃。这个器官大约有药球那么大，本质上是一个四十五加仑的发酵罐，里面居住着一群以草为食的细菌。这些细菌在食物链的远端过着看不见的生活，最终形成了汉堡包，就像草一样，它们与它们喂养的牛共同进化。对于所有相关人员来说，这确实是一个出色的系统：对于草，对于细菌，对于动物，对于我们这些动物的食者。
answer_zh: 牛和草形成了互惠互利的关系：牛只有吃草才能生存，而这个过程可以帮助草扩展、传播和使种子受精，而牛体内从草到蛋白质的转化高度依赖于体积和容量都巨大的瘤胃。

question: Armed police have been brought into NSW schools to reduce crime rates and educate students. The 40 School Liaison Police (SLP) oﬃcers have been allocated to public and private high schools across the state. Organizers say the oﬃcers, who began work last week, will build positive relationships between police and students. But parent groups warned of the potential dangers of armed police working at schools in communities where police relations were already under strain. Among their duties, the SLPs will conduct crime prevention workshops, talking to students about issues including shoplifting, oﬀensive behavior, graﬃti and drugs, and alcohol. They can also advise school principals. One SLP, Constable Ben Purvis, began work in the inner Sydney region last week, including at Alexandria Park Community Schools senior campus. Previously stationed as a crime prevention oﬃcer at The Rocks, he now has 27 schools under his jurisdiction in areas including The Rocks, Redfern and Kings Cross. Constable Purvis said the full-time position would see him working on the broader issues of crime prevention. I am not a security guard, he said. I am not there to patrol the school. We want to improve relationships between police and schoolchildren, to have a positive interaction. We are coming to the school and giving them the knowledge to improve their own safety. " The use of fake ID among older students is among the issues he has already discussed with principals. Parents ' groups responded to the program positively but said it might spark a range of community reactions. "It is a good thing, and an innovative idea and there could be some positive beneﬁts, " Council of Catholic School Parents executive oﬃcer Danielle Cronin said. "Diﬀerent communities will respond to this kind of presence in diﬀerent ways.
answer: The armed police in NSW schools raised a debate between organizers, who believe it can build positive relationship between police and students, and parents who are concerned about the potential dangers, and the police have a range of duties including advising the
question_zh: 新南威尔士州的学校已配备武装警察，以降低犯罪率并教育学生。 40 名学校联络警察 (SLP) 人员已被分配到全州的公立和私立高中。组织者表示，上周开始工作的警官将在警察和学生之间建立积极的关系。但家长团体警告称，武装警察在警察关系已经紧张的社区学校工作可能存在危险。 SLP 的职责之一是举办预防犯罪研讨会，与学生讨论入店行窃、攻击性行为、涂鸦、毒品和酒精等问题。他们还可以为校长提供建议。一名 SLP 警员 Ben Purvis 上周开始在悉尼内城区工作，其中包括亚历山大公园社区学校的高年级校园。他此前曾在岩石区担任预防犯罪官员，现在管辖下包括岩石区、雷德芬和国王十字在内的 27 所学校。珀维斯警官表示，这个全职职位将使他致力于更广泛的预防犯罪问题。我不是保安，他说。我不是来学校巡逻的。我们希望改善警察和学生之间的关系，进行积极的互动。我们来到学校，向他们传授提高自身安全的知识。 “高年级学生使用假身份证的问题是他已经与校长讨论过的问题之一。家长团体对该计划做出了积极回应，但表示这可能会引发一系列社区反应。天主教学校家长委员会执行官丹妮尔·克罗宁 (Danielle Cronin) 表示：“这是一件好事，是一个创新的想法，可能会带来一些积极的好处。”“不同的社区将以不同的方式应对这种存在。
answer_zh: 新南威尔士州学校的武装警察在组织者和担心潜在危险的家长之间引发了一场争论，组织者认为这可以在警察和学生之间建立积极的关系，而警察有一系列职责，包括向学校提供建议。

question: When Namibia gained independence in 1990, teenager Pascolena Florry was herding goats in the country 's dry, desolate northern savannah. Her job, unpaid and dangerous, was to protect her parents ' livestock from preying jackals and leopards. She saw wildlife as the enemy, and many of the other indigenous inhabitants of Namibia 's rural communal lands shared her view. Wildlife poaching was commonplace. Fifteen years later, 31-year-old Pascolena 's life and outlook are very diﬀerent. She has built a previously undreamed career in tourism and is the ﬁrst black Namibian to be appointed a manager of a guest lodge. Her village and hundreds of others have directly beneﬁted from government eﬀorts to devolve management and tourism development on communal lands to conservancies run by indigenous peoples. Now we seewildlife as our way of creating jobs and opportunities as the tourism industry grows, she says. The future is better with wildlife around, not only for jobs but also for the environment
answer: Pascolena Florry, who used to work to prevent livestock being harmed by wildlife at her early age, now has a more promising career in the tourism industry working as a manager of a guest lodge, and this change in career proved to be beneﬁcial and resulted from the government’s eﬀort to decentralize and assign jobs to those living in a disadvantaged situation.
question_zh: 1990 年纳米比亚获得独立时，少年帕斯科莱纳·弗洛里 (Pascolena Florry) 正在该国干燥、荒凉的北部大草原放牧山羊。她的工作既无报酬又危险，是保护父母的牲畜免遭豺狼和豹子的捕食。她将野生动物视为敌人，纳米比亚农村公共土地上的许多其他土著居民也同意她的观点。野生动物偷猎司空见惯。十五年后，31岁的帕斯科莱纳的生活和人生观发生了很大的变化。她在旅游业建立了以前从未梦想过的职业生涯，并且是第一位被任命为宾馆经理的纳米比亚黑人。她的村庄和其他数百个村庄直接受益于政府将公共土地上的管理和旅游业开发移交给土著人民经营的保护区的努力。她说，现在，随着旅游业的发展，我们将野生动物视为创造就业和机会的方式。有野生动物在，未来会更美好，不仅有利于就业，也有利于环境
answer_zh: 帕斯科莱娜·弗洛里 (Pascolena Florry) 早年曾从事防止牲畜受到野生动物伤害的工作，现在在旅游业拥有更前途光明的职业，担任宾馆经理，事实证明这种职业转变是有益的，是政府努力将工作权力下放并将工作分配给生活弱势群体的结果。

question: Why and to what extent should parents control their children 's TV watching? There is certainly nothing inherently wrong with TV. The problem is how much television a child watches and what eﬀect it has on his life. Research has shown that as the amount of time spent watching TV goes up, the amount of time devoted not only to homework and study but other important aspects of life such as social development and physical activities decreases. Television is bound to have a tremendous impact on a child, both in terms of how many hours a week he watches TV and of what he sees. When a parent is concerned about the eﬀects of television, he should consider a number of things that TV oﬀers the child in terms of information and knowledge, how many hours a week a youngster his age should watch television, the impact of violence and sex, and the inﬂuence of commercials. What about the family as a whole? Is the TV set a central piece of furniture in your home? Is it picked on the moment someone enters the empty house? Is it on during the daytime? Is it part of the background noise of your family life? Do you demonstrate by your own viewing that television should be watched selectively?
answer: The research shows that for children, the amount of time of television viewing and the amount spent on other social activities are negatively correlated and that the impact of television on children can only be discussed after considering a wide range of issues, whereas television indeed exerts a profound inﬂuence on the family as a whole.
question_zh: 父母为什么以及在多大程度上应该控制孩子看电视？电视本身并没有什么问题。问题是孩子看多少电视以及电视对他的生活有何影响。研究表明，随着看电视时间的增加，不仅花在家庭作业和学习上的时间减少，而且花在生活其他重要方面（例如社交发展和体育活动）的时间也会减少。电视必然会对孩子产生巨大的影响，无论是在他每周看电视的时间还是他所看到的内容方面。当父母担心电视的影响时，他应该考虑电视为孩子提供的信息和知识方面的一些内容，同龄的孩子每周应该看电视多少小时，暴力和性的影响以及广告的影响。整个家庭又如何呢？电视机是您家中的核心家具吗？是在有人进入空房子的那一刻就选择的吗？白天有开吗？它是你家庭生活背景噪音的一部分吗？您是否通过自己的观看证明应该有选择地观看电视？
answer_zh: 研究表明，对于儿童来说，看电视的时间和花在其他社交活动上的时间是负相关的，电视对儿童的影响需要综合考虑才能讨论，而电视确实对整个家庭产生深远的影响。

question: As far as prediction is concerned, remember that the chairman of IBM predicted in the ﬁfties that the world would need a maximum of around half a dozen computers, and the British Department for Education seemed to think in the eighties that we would all need to be able to code in BASIC and that in the nineties Microsoft failed to foresee the rapid growth of the Internet. Who could have predicted that one major eﬀect of the automobile would be to bankrupt small shops across the nation? Could the early developers of the telephone have foreseen its development as a medium for person-to-person communication, rather than as a form of broadcasting medium? We all, including the 'experts ', seem to be peculiarly inept at predicting the likely development of our technologies, even as far as the next year. We can, of course, try to extrapolate from the experience of previous technologies, as I do below by comparing the technology of the Internet with the development of other information and communication technologies and by examining the earlier development of radio and print. But how justiﬁed I might be in doing so remains an open question. You might conceivably ﬁnd the history of the British and French videotext systems, Prestel and Minitel, instructive. However, I am not entirely convinced that they are very relevant, nor do I know where you can ﬁnd information about them online, so, rather than take up space here, I 've brieﬂy described them in a separate article.
answer: We all, including the “experts”, seem to be peculiarly inept at predicting the likely development of our technologies, given facts that IBM chairman, the British Department for Education and Microsoft failed to foresee future trends whereas developers of automobile and telephone failed to predict the development, but we can extrapolate from experience of previous technologies even though how justiﬁed we might be in doing so remains an open question.
question_zh: 就预测而言，请记住，IBM 董事长在 50 年代预测，世界最多需要大约六台计算机，而英国教育部似乎在 80 年代认为，我们都需要能够使用 BASIC 进行编码，而在 90 年代，微软未能预见到互联网的快速发展。谁能预料到汽车的一大影响会导致全国各地的小商店破产？电话的早期开发者能否预见到它会发展为人与人之间的通信媒介，而不是广播媒介？我们所有人，包括“专家”，似乎都特别不擅长预测我们的技术可能的发展，即使是明年。当然，我们可以尝试从以前技术的经验中进行推断，正如我在下面通过将互联网技术与其他信息和通信技术的发展进行比较以及通过研究广播和印刷的早期发展所做的那样。但我这样做的合理性仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。您可能会发现英国和法国的视频文本系统、Prestel 和 Minitel 的历史很有启发性。然而，我并不完全相信它们非常相关，也不知道在哪里可以在线找到有关它们的信息，因此，我不想在这里占用空间，而是在另一篇文章中简要描述了它们。
answer_zh: 鉴于 IBM 董事长、英国教育部和微软未能预见未来趋势，而汽车和电话开发商也未能预测发展，我们所有人，包括“专家”，似乎都特别不擅长预测我们技术的可能发展，但我们可以从以前技术的经验中进行推断，尽管我们这样做的合理性仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

question: Since Australians Jennifer Hawkins and Lauryn Eagle were crowned Miss Universe and Miss Teen International respectively, there has been a dramatic increase in interest in beauty pageants in this country. These wins have also sparked a debate as to whether beauty pageants are just harmless reminders of old-fashioned values or a throwback to the days when women were respected for how good they looked. Opponents argue that beauty pageants, whether it 's Miss Universe or Miss Teen International, are demeaning to women and out of sync with the times. They say they are nothing more than symbols of decline. In the past few decades, Australia has taken more than a few faltering steps toward treating women with dignity and respect. Young women are being brought up knowing that they can do anything, as shown by inspiring role models in medicine such as 2003 Australian of the Year Professor Fiona Stanley. In the 1960s and 70s, one of the ﬁrst acts of the feminist movement was to picket beauty pageants on the premise that the industry promoted the view that it was acceptable to judge women on their appearance. Today many young Australian women are still profoundly uncomfortable with their body image, feeling under all kinds of pressure because they are judged by how they look. Almost all of the pageant victors are wafer-thin, reinforcing the message that thin equals beautiful. This ignores the fact that men and women come in all sizes and shapes.
